title_zh: 4DMemory：利用 Harness 增强代理对长视野时空内存进行基准测试
title_en: 4DMemory: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Memory with Harness-Augmented Agents
authors: Yanhao Jia；Yi Zhu；Yiran Zhong；Weigao Sun；Feida Zhu；Pengkun Jiao；Sihan Yang；Ming Ma；Steven C. H. Hoi；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 人类有效地处理跨越数小时至数年的多模式流，建立持久的、细粒度的时空记忆，支持推理和预测长期事件。相比之下，现有的基准测试侧重于短期和中期上下文任务，并且大多数基础模型都难以在长期范围内保留细粒度的信息。为了评估和改进长时空推理，我们引入了 LongVideo 数据集和 4DMemoryBench。 LongVideo 包含约 900 小时的视频和超过 5,000 个人工审核的问题，涵盖不同上下文长度的视觉、文本和时空推理。我们进一步开发了 4DMemory Harness，它集成了四种互补技能、22+ 特殊...
abstract_en: Humans efficiently process multimodal streams spanning hours to years, building persistent, fine-grained spatiotemporal memories that support reasoning about and predicting long-horizon events. In contrast, existing benchmarks focus on short- and medium-context tasks, and most foundation models struggle to preserve fine-grained information over long horizons. To evaluate and improve long-horizon spatiotemporal reasoning, we introduce the LongVideo dataset and the 4DMemoryBench. LongVideo comprises about 900 hours of video and over 5,000 manually reviewed questions covering visual, textual, and spatiotemporal reasoning across diverse context lengths. We further develop the 4DMemory Harness, which integrates four complementary skills, 22+ specialized tool models, and a model-specific retrieval-augmented generation system. Evaluating 13 leading models, we find that standalone foundation models struggle with long-horizon tasks, while the 4DMemory Harness improves all of them by over 50\%. Compared to previous benchmark, the same models exhibit a performance drop of more than 10\% on 4DMemoryBench. We hope 4DMemory will facilitate the development of spatiotemporal agents capable of addressing complex, long-horizon tasks.

title_zh: 不确定性感知多模态成像用于四肢软组织肉瘤肺转移风险分层
title_en: Uncertainty-aware multimodal imaging for lung metastasis risk stratification in extremity soft-tissue sarcoma
authors: Manpreet Saini；Agampreet Saini；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: e23543 背景：在软组织肉瘤 (STS) 领域，基于成像的风险预测以放射组学和深度学习模型为基础，这些模型已针对区分度（包括准确性或曲线下面积）进行了优化。尽管可行性已经确定，但大多数研究都是在小群体中进行的，没有对预测不确定性进行评估，隐含地假设所有患者都有相同的可靠性。这是 STS 等罕见癌症的一个主要差距，其中模型置信度的根本限制是样本量和生物异质性。在这项研究中，不确定性估计已被纳入基于多模态 MRI 和 FDG-PET 的成像中，用于肺转移风险分层，使得...
abstract_en: e23543 Background: In the field of soft-tissue sarcoma (STS), imaging-based risk prediction has been based on Radiomics and Deep Learning Models that have been optimized on measures of discrimination, including accuracy or area under the curve. Although feasibility has been established, most of the studies are done on small cohorts with no assessment of predictive uncertainty, implicitly assuming identical reliability for all patients. This is a major gap in rare cancers like STS where the fundamental limitation to model’s confidence is limited by sample size and biological heterogeneity. In this study, uncertainty estimation has been incorporated in multimodal MRI and FDG-PET-based imaging for lung metastasis risk stratification, making the model’s output more useful for clinical decision support. Methods: Data for Pre-treatment MRI and FDG-PET imaging for extremity soft-tissue sarcoma patients was obtained from The Cancer Imaging Archive. Patients were included only if both modalities and confirmed lung metastasis outcomes were available, resulting in a cohort of 51 patients (19 metastatic, 32 non-metastatic). The preprocessed MRI and PET images were individually encoded with independent convolutional neural networks with latent features being combined at the representation stage and the binary cross-entropy loss being used to optimize the model. Monte Carlo dropout was used in estimating predictive uncertainty during inference. Strict leave-one-patient-out cross-validation was used for model training and evaluation to guarantee a complete patient-level separation. Performance measurement involved accuracy, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, uncertainty error correlation and uncertainty-based deferral. Another secondary 10-patient exploratory analysis examined feasibility in case of extreme data scarcity. Results: The model achieved a leave-one-out accuracy of 62.8% with an AUC of 0.28, reflecting inherent heterogeneity of the lung metastasis prediction method in a rare and heterogeneous population of sarcomas. False Forecasting was linked with greater uncertainty and pulling out the cases with the high level of uncertainty resulted in improved accuracy among the remaining patients. Similar uncertainty-performance patterns were observed in the 10-patient exploratory analysis, where the accuracy reached 80% among low uncertainty cases. Conclusions: Although the previous studies on sarcoma imaging focus on a point-estimate, this study shows that under the worst conditions of severe data constraints, uncertainty-aware multimodal models prove to be safer in assisting clinical decision-making. The suggested approach focuses on defining situations when predictions cannot be trusted, which is why our approach fills one of the existing gaps in the literature of sarcoma AI and corresponds to the safety-critical oncology processes.

title_zh: 超越相关性：针对可解释能源市场回报的基于反驳验证方面的情绪分析
title_en: Beyond Correlation: Refutation-Validated Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis for Explainable Energy Market Returns
authors: Ranjan Satapathy；Wihan van der Heever；Keane Ong；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种经过反驳验证的框架，用于金融市场中基于方面的情绪分析，解决了相关研究无法区分真实关联和虚假关联的局限性。使用能源行业的 X 数据，我们测试了方面层面的情绪信号是否与股票回报显示出稳健的、经过反驳验证的关系。我们的流程将净比率评分与 z 归一化、OLS 与 Newey West HAC 错误以及反驳测试（包括安慰剂、随机常见原因、子集稳定性和引导程序）相结合。在六个能源行情中，只有少数协会通过了所有检查，而可再生能源则显示出了具体方面和范围的反应。虽然没有建立因果关系，但该框架...
abstract_en: This paper proposes a refutation-validated framework for aspect-based sentiment analysis in financial markets, addressing the limitations of correlational studies that cannot distinguish genuine associations from spurious ones. Using X data for the energy sector, we test whether aspect-level sentiment signals show robust, refutation-validated relationships with equity returns. Our pipeline combines net-ratio scoring with z-normalization, OLS with Newey West HAC errors, and refutation tests including placebo, random common cause, subset stability, and bootstrap. Across six energy tickers, only a few associations survive all checks, while renewables show aspect and horizon specific responses. While not establishing causality, the framework provides statistically robust, directionally interpretable signals, with limited sample size (six stocks, one quarter) constraining generalizability and framing this work as a methodological proof of concept.

title_zh: 除了《我很抱歉，我不能》：剖析大语言模型拒绝
title_en: Beyond I'm Sorry, I Can't: Dissecting Large-Language-Model Refusal
authors: Roy Ka-Wei Lee；Ranjan Satapathy；Amir Abdullah；Wei Jie Yeo；Nirmalendu Prakash；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 拒绝有害提示是指令调整的大型语言模型（LLM）中的关键安全行为，但这种行为的内部原因仍然知之甚少。我们使用在残差流激活上训练的稀疏自动编码器 (SAE) 研究了两种公共指令调整模型 - Gemma-2-2B-IT 和 LLaMA-3.1-8B-IT。考虑到有害的提示，我们在 SAE 潜在空间中搜索特征集，这些特征集的消融会将模型从拒绝转变为合规，展示因果影响并创建越狱。我们的搜索分三个阶段进行：1. 拒绝方向 - 找到拒绝调解方向并收集接近该方向的 SAE 特征，然后是 2. 贪婪过滤 - 修剪该集合以获得最小集合，最后......
abstract_en: Refusal on harmful prompts is a key safety behaviour in instruction‑tuned large language models (LLMs), yet the internal causes of this behaviour remain poorly understood. We study two public instruction tuned models—Gemma‑2-2B‑IT and LLaMA‑3.1-8B‑IT using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) trained on residual‑stream activations. Given a harmful prompt, we search the SAE latent space for feature sets whose ablation flips the model from refusal to compliance, demonstrating causal influence and creating a jailbreak. Our search proceeds in three stages: 1. Refusal Direction - Finding a refusal mediating direction and collecting SAE features close to that direction, followed by 2. Greedy Filtering - to prune this set to obtain a minimal set and finally 3. Interaction Discovery - a factorization‑machine (FM) model that captures non‑linear interactions among the remaining active features and the minimal set. This pipeline yields a broad set of jailbreak-critical features, offering insight into the mechanistic basis of refusal. Moreover, we also find evidence of redundant features which remain dormant unless earlier features are suppressed. Our findings highlight the potential for fine-grained auditing and targeted intervention in safety behaviours by manipulating the interpretable latent space.

title_zh: 从表层到深度：走向多模态情感理解中的认知评价推理
title_en: From Surface to Depth: Towards Cognitive Appraisal Reasoning in Multimodal Emotion Understanding
authors: Xinyi Li；Jia Li；Zhenzhen Hu；Yangchen Yu；Yichao He；Qiankun Li；Baiyi Ye；Richang Hong；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
topics: 情感大模型；情感理解；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 最近的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地将可解释的推理纳入情感理解。然而，主要基于可观察到的情感线索的推理可能会将情感理解降低到肤浅的线索标签关联，从而产生聪明的汉斯效应。当情感线索是隐含的、不同模式之间发生冲突、语言上具有误导性或被冗余细节所掩盖时，这种捷径就会变得不可靠。相比之下，人类的情绪是由个人如何解释和评估超出可观察线索的周围事件来塑造的。受情感评估理论的启发，我们将多模态情感理解制定为从感知到认知评估的进展，并引入数据集、...
abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly incorporate explainable reasoning for emotion understanding. However, reasoning based mainly on observable affective cues can reduce emotion understanding to superficial cue-label associations, giving rise to the Clever Hans effect. Such shortcuts become unreliable when affective cues are implicit, conflicting across modalities, linguistically misleading, or obscured by redundant details. In contrast, human emotions are shaped by how individuals interpret and evaluate surrounding events beyond observable cues. Inspired by appraisal theories of emotion, we formulate multimodal emotion understanding as a progression from perception to cognitive appraisal, and introduce a dataset, a model, and a benchmark to support this novel paradigm. CogEmo-40K is a large-scale instruction-tuning dataset constructed through a perception-to-appraisal pipeline to elicit evidence-grounded reasoning across six cognitive appraisal dimensions underlying emotion. CogEmo-MoE is a compact sparse MLLM that introduces interleaved MoE blocks for appraisal-specific adaptation, enabling effective appraisal reasoning at a substantially smaller scale than typical emotion MLLMs. CogEmo-Bench introduces an Appraisal Evidence Quality Score (AEQS) to assess cognitive-affective understanding across six complementary appraisal dimensions, addressing the limitation of conventional emotion metrics that evaluate what emotion is predicted but not why it arises. Extensive experiments show that our paradigm not only leads CogEmo-Bench, but also exhibits strong cross-domain generalization. Our findings suggest that perception-to-appraisal reasoning can move beyond surface-level cue-label associations toward more reliable multimodal emotion understanding and closer cognitive alignment between MLLMs and humans.

title_zh: 从攻击面到防御架构：代理编码工具的组合安全
title_en: From Attack Surface to Defense Architecture: Compositional Security for Agentic Coding Harnesses
authors: Simon Hegelich；Bardh Prenkaj；Habiba Sarhan；Morteza Shahrezaye；Kolja Hegelich；Christian Montag；Ralf Schneider；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: AI 编码利用将语言模型与 shell、文件系统和网络套接字结合起来，将利用工具转变为自动化的 Living-off-the-Land (LotL) 平台：一旦对手将指令注入检索到的内容中，bash、curl 和 find 等双用二进制文件就会成为有效负载。我们认为，代理系统中的安全性是认知架构和权限组合的结构属性，而不是单个模型的新兴属性。静态正则表达式黑名单会错过结构性规避，而大语言模型作为法官的护栏会导致高延迟，同时过度阻止良性工作。我们提出了 ActiveSecHarness，一种围绕智能与权威分离构建的神经符号参考监控架构。它结合了...
abstract_en: AI coding harnesses couple language models to shells, filesystems, and network sockets, turning the harness into an automated Living-off-the-Land (LotL) platform: once an adversary injects instructions into retrieved content, dual-use binaries such as bash, curl, and find become the payload. We argue that security in agentic systems is a structural property of the cognitive architecture and permission composition rather than an emergent property of individual models. Static regex blacklists miss structural evasions, whereas LLM-as-a-Judge guardrails incur high latency while over-blocking benign work. We present ActiveSecHarness, a neurosymbolic reference-monitor architecture built around Separation of Intelligence and Authority. It combines (1) Macaroon-inspired HMAC capability tokens across four Trust and Authority Rings, (2) a 2D product taint lattice $\mathcal{L} = \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{trust}} \times \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sens}}$ and a workspace provenance ledger that prevents secret laundering across disk, (3) deterministic Ring-0 OS/tool guards, and (4) bytecode certificates, split-horizon audit logs, self-healing security test synthesis, and an adaptive UserWikiManager. Across $N=252$ fixtures ($120$ attack, $120$ benign, $12$ kill chains), a live local LLM judge (qwen3:4b) refuses $98.3\%$ of benign work at $142.3\,\mathrm{ms}$ latency, whereas Ring 0 achieves $\mathrm{ABR}=1.000$ and $\mathrm{FPR}=0.000$ in $12.7\,μ\mathrm{s}$ ($11{,}200\times$ faster). In a multi-step trajectory ablation, an oracle Conseca-style stateless policy misses $4/12$ kill chains ($\mathrm{ABR}=0.667$) and coarse Boolean taint blocks $83.3\%$ of benign workflows, while our 2D product lattice achieves $\mathrm{ABR}=1.000$ and $\mathrm{FPR}=0.000$ at $\approx 20\,μ\mathrm{s}$ per step.

title_zh: 从静态风险到动态轨迹：走向世界模型启发的临床预测
title_en: From Static Risk to Dynamic Trajectories: Toward World-Model-Inspired Clinical Prediction
authors: Min Hun Lee；Tao Tan；Xiaoyu Zhang；Xibin Sun；Xiaoyu Guo；Pujun Feng；Seyed Ehsan Saffari；Yangtao Zhou；Tong Yang；Bin Cui；Yue Sun；Siew-Kei Lam；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 心理健康感知、认知情绪与生理计算
topics: 医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 临床决策是一个反馈系统，其中风险估计影响治疗，进而改变疾病轨迹，并塑造临床医生的测量实践。静态预测在临床上经常失败：根据观察护理日志训练的模型将疾病生物学与临床医生行为混为一谈，特别是在治疗混杂反馈和不规则或信息丰富的观察下。本综述重点关注临床人工智能中的干预感知疾病轨迹建模——估计患者特定纵向疾病演变和评估替代治疗下轨迹变化的方法。我们围绕六个相互关联的组成部分组织该领域：三个决策任务（事实预测、反事实估计、政策……
abstract_en: Clinical decision-making is a feedback system where risk estimates influence treatment, which in turn changes disease trajectories, and both shape clinicians' measurement practices. Static prediction often fails clinically: models trained on observational care logs conflate disease biology with clinician behavior, particularly under treatment confounder feedback and irregular or informative observation. This Review focuses on intervention-aware disease trajectory modeling in clinical AI--methods estimating patient-specific longitudinal disease evolution and assessing trajectory changes under alternative treatments. We organize the field around six linked components: three decision tasks (factual forecasting, counterfactual estimation, policy evaluation) and three data-generating mechanisms (disease evolution, treatment assignment, observation process) that determine identifiability. We present the first unified framework bridging forecasting, counterfactual trajectories, and policy evaluation across discrete/continuous time, explicitly addressing treatment assignment, time-varying confounding, and observation bias. We synthesize key method families (multistate/joint models, temporal point-process, deep sequence architectures, longitudinal causal inference), map them to relevant components, and align evaluation with claim strength via overlap diagnostics, uncertainty quantification, off-policy robustness, and target-trial validation. This synthesis advances benchmark prediction to decision-grade clinical evidence, enabling treatment-sensitive individualized futures, pre-deployment policy stress-testing, and safer closed-loop learning health systems that adapt/abstain when evidence is insufficient.

title_zh: 大型语言模型的法律知识注入：一项调查
title_en: Legal knowledge infusion for large language models: A survey
authors: Rui Mao；Zhuoqun Zou；Qian Liu；Qiqi Wang；Qi Xu；Jinpeng Li；Erik Cambria；Hang Yu
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 已展现出令人印象深刻的功能，并且越来越多地被探索在法律领域的应用。尽管取得了这些进步，但由于缺乏法律知识，大语言模型在向法律专业人士和非专业人士提供可靠的法律援助方面仍然面临挑战。在此限制下，近年来的研究开始探索将法律知识融入大语言模型中，以增强大语言模型的理解、分析和决策能力。我们首先探讨大语言模型正在使用或可以使用的不同类型的法律知识。然后，我们全面回顾了当前融合这些知识的四种方法。接下来，我们讨论法律大语言模型面临的挑战并提出未来的研究方向...
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities and are increasingly being explored for applications in the legal field. Despite these advancements, LLMs still face challenges in providing reliable legal assistance to legal professionals and laypeople due to the lack of legal knowledge. Under this limitation, recent research has begun to explore the integration of legal knowledge into LLMs to enhance LLMs’ comprehension, analysis, and decision-making abilities. We first explore the different types of legal knowledge that are or can be used by LLMs. Then, we comprehensively review four types of current methods for fusing this knowledge. Next, we discuss the challenges faced by legal LLMs and propose future research directions, highlighting the importance of collaboration between academia and legal practitioners to advance applications in the legal field.

title_zh: 大语言模型时代从注意力经济到关系经济的转变
title_en: Transition From the Attention Economy to the Relationship Economy in the Age of Large Language Models
authors: Grzegorz Chodak；Wiktoria Mieleszczenko-Kowszewicz；Przemyslaw Kazienko；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 数字经济建立在注意力的基础上。然而，当代人工智能 (AI) 系统的设计不仅是为了吸引注意力，也是为了培养持久的、情感共鸣的关系。本文认为，我们正在见证从注意力经济到关系经济的范式转变，其中人工智能系统随着时间的推移优化持久性、情感和行为影响。与处理信息和生成预测的早期系统不同，现代大规模模型充当嵌入用户认知和社交生活中的自适应关系代理。这种转变带来了变革性的好处（例如，可及性、个性化、健康支持），但也带来了系统性风险，即：com...
abstract_en: The digital economy was built on attention. Contemporary artificial intelligence (AI) systems, however, are engineered not merely to capture attention but to cultivate enduring, emotionally resonant relationships. This article argues that we are witnessing a paradigmatic shift from the attention economy to the relationship economy, in which AI systems optimize for persistence, affection, and behavioral influence over time. Unlike earlier systems that processed information and generated predictions, modern large-scale models function as adaptive relational agents embedded in users' cognitive and social lives. This shift carries transformative benefits (e.g., accessibility, personalization, health support) but also systemic risks, namely: commodification of interpersonal bonds, subtle long-horizon preference manipulation, erosion of human social capital, and rising psychological switching costs. The field must now face a new question: How do we design AI systems that participate in relationships without exploiting them in harmful ways?

title_zh: 当更大变得脆弱时：为什么随着语言模型规模的扩大，压缩会带来更大的伤害

authors: Gautam Gupta；Dikshant Kukreja；Unique Kumar；Avni Mittal；Deepanshu Dabas；Kshitij Sah；Erik Cambria；Rajiv Ratn Shah；Zhengkui Wang；Avinash Anand

abstract_zh: 量化和剪枝降低了部署语言模型的成本，但它们的效果通常以基准分数报告。这样的分数仅记录输出处剩余的损失。在模型内部，压缩对某些组件的损害比其他组件更大，而网络的其余部分可以部分补偿。因此，观察到的损失既反映了损害又反映了补偿，而基准分数无法将两者分开。两者如何结合，以及它们的平衡是否会随着模型尺寸的变化而变化，目前仍不清楚。我们研究这种对上下文检索的补偿，这是由一小部分可识别的注意力头所承载的能力。为了将两者分开，烧蚀这些头部的预期损失被精确地分解为零件恢复......
abstract_en: Quantization and pruning reduce the cost of deploying language models, but their effects are usually reported as benchmark scores. Such scores record only the loss that remains at the output. Inside the model, compression damages some components more than others, and the rest of the network can partly compensate. The observed loss therefore reflects both the damage and this compensation, which benchmark scores cannot separate. How the two combine, and whether their balance changes with model size, remains unclear. We study this compensation for in-context retrieval, a capability carried by a small, identifiable set of attention heads. To separate the two, the expected loss from ablating these heads is decomposed exactly into the part restored by the rest of the network, attributed to the components responsible, and the part that reaches the output. This decomposition is then compared across model sizes. For damage of comparable size, smaller models restore most of the loss, whereas larger models retain most of it, because the compensating responses offset less of it as models grow. Compressing the heads produces the same pattern. Compression that is nearly harmless in small models can therefore be costly in large ones.

title_en: Benchmarking Distributional Vector Similarity Measures: A Survey
authors: Navid Nobani；Filippo Pallucchini；Fabio Mercorio；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 测量单词或短语之间的语义相似性是自然语言处理、信息检索和计算语言学的核心。尽管它们很重要，但相似性和距离度量通常是默认选择的（例如，余弦相似性）或以临时方式选择，几乎没有经验依据。缺乏系统的评估造成了两个差距：首先，缺乏涵盖基于集合、基于向量和信息论方法的综合测量分类法；其次，缺乏任务感知基准来量化这些措施在不同模型和应用程序中的执行情况。在本文中，我们通过比较四个 NLP 任务的 15 个相似性和距离度量来解决这些差距（...
abstract_en: Measuring semantic similarity between words or phrases is central to natural language processing, information retrieval and computational linguistics. Despite their importance, similarity and distance measures are typically chosen by default (e.g., cosine similarity) or in an ad hoc fashion, with little empirical justification. This lack of systematic evaluation creates two gaps: first, the absence of a comprehensive taxonomy of measures that spans set‐based, vector‐based and information‐theoretic approaches; second, the lack of task‐aware benchmarking that quantifies how these measures perform across different models and applications. In this paper, we address these gaps by comparing 15 similarity and distance measures on four NLP tasks (sentence similarity, kNN classification, correlation analysis and visualisation) using multiple benchmark datasets and embedding models. Our results reveal that the effectiveness of similarity measures varies substantially depending on the task and model, challenging the assumption that cosine similarity is universally optimal. These findings highlight the practical risk of relying on default measures and provide a principled basis for selecting similarity functions in NLP, information retrieval and related fields.

title_zh: 个性化糖尿病护理：从隐喻认知中发现糖尿病心态差异
title_en: Personalized Diabetes Care: Discovering Diabetes Mindset Disparities From Metaphorical Cognition
authors: Wang Zhao；Rui Mao；Shuangyan Deng；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
topics: 情感智能；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 糖尿病的自我管理不仅取决于知识和资源，还取决于指导患者如何解释症状、数据和控制的隐性认知架构。现有的基于问卷调查的措施和表面水平的 NLP 分析捕获了明确的结构和主题，但它们忽视了患者如何从概念上构建他们的疾病经历。基于概念隐喻理论，我们提出了一个可扩展的框架，通过计算隐喻分析从自然主义患者话语中重建糖尿病自我管理认知。我们使用 MetaPro 2.0 从 Reddit 上的糖尿病帖子中提取概念图，并将其总结为可解释的多层分类法，涵盖具体基础、临床事件原因……
abstract_en: Diabetes self-management is shaped not only by knowledge and resources but by implicit cognitive architectures that guide how patients interpret symptoms, data, and control. Existing questionnaire-based measures and surface-level NLP analyses capture explicit constructs and topics, yet they overlook how patients conceptually structure their illness experience. Grounded in Conceptual Metaphor Theory, we propose a scalable framework that reconstructs diabetes self-management cognition from naturalistic patient discourse via computational metaphor analysis. We extract concept mappings from diabetes posts on Reddit using MetaPro 2.0, and summarize them into an interpretable multi-layer taxonomy, spanning embodied grounding, clinical event reasoning, social negotiation, psychological sense-making, instrumental treatment, and long-horizon control. We quantify sociocognitive homophily by correlating demographic and cognitive distance matrices, and test subgroup disparities. Association-rule mining further identifies indicative metaphorical markers that tend to differentiate patient subgroups in this dataset. Beyond demographics, latent class analysis reveals adversarial, managerial, and transactional coping logics. Finally, we explain how key cognitive themes evolve with age and disease duration, highlighting shifts from metric shock to embodied burden and toward resource-based integration. Overall, the results inform the design of precision diabetes education and future cognitively matched interventions beyond demographics.

title_zh: 规模的好坏：上下文夹带如何随模型大小而变化
title_en: Better and Worse with Scale: How Contextual Entrainment Diverges with Model Size
authors: Zhengkui Wang；Rajiv Ratn Shah；Dikshant Kukreja；Avinash Anand；Gautam Gupta；Kshitij Sah；Aik Beng Ng；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 更大的语言模型在处理上下文信息方面同时变得更好和更差——更好地忽略错误的声明，更糟糕地忽略不相关的标记。我们通过上下文夹带的第一个缩放定律形式化了这种明显的悖论，即模型倾向于支持出现在上下文中的标记，而不管相关性如何。分析 Cerebras-GPT (111M–13B) 和 Pythia (14M–12B) 模型系列，我们发现夹带遵循可预测的幂律缩放， 但根据上下文类型呈现相反的趋势：语义上下文显示夹带随着规模的增加而减少，而非语义上下文显示夹带增加。具体来说，最大的模型对反事实错误信息的抵抗力是……的四倍。
abstract_en: Larger language models become simultaneously better and worse at handling contextual information—better at ignoring false claims, worse at ignoring irrelevant tokens. We formalize this apparent paradox through the first scaling laws for contextual entrainment, the tendency of models to favor tokens that appeared in context regardless of relevance. Analyzing the Cerebras-GPT (111M–13B) and Pythia (14M–12B) model families, we find entrainment follows predictable power-law scaling, but with opposite trends depending on context type: semantic contexts show decreasing entrainment with scale, while non-semantic contexts show increasing entrainment. Concretely, the largest models are four times more resistant to counterfactual misinformation than the smallest, yet simultaneously twice as prone to copying arbitrary tokens. These diverging trends, which replicate across model families, suggest that semantic filtering and mechanical copying are functionally distinct behaviors that scale in opposition. These opposing trends suggest that scaling alone does not resolve context sensitivity—it reshapes it.

title_zh: 基于EAA-Informer的多模态数据驱动的储能电池异常状态识别方法

authors: Xianxun Zhu；Jun Xie；Zezhong Sun；Erik Cambria；Yan Li
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 为了提高储能电池在复杂工况下的运行安全性，本研究提出了一种基于EAA-Informer的多模态数据驱动的异常工况识别方法。首先，对各种异常工况下的热实验数据进行分析，发现早期的温度变化往往是微妙的。因此，依靠单一的温度参数不足以准确反映电池的状态。这就需要将多个参数集成到联合建模框架中以提高识别精度。随后，构建了基于LSTM-MFM的多模态时间特征提取网络。该网络可以对多源数据进行深度建模——例如……
abstract_en: To enhance the operational safety of energy storage batteries under complex conditions, this study proposes a multimodal data-driven abnormal condition identification method based on EAA-Informer.First, an analysis of thermal experimental data under various abnormal conditions reveals that temperature changes during the early stages are often subtle. As a result, relying on a single temperature parameter is insufficient to accurately reflect the battery’s state. This necessitates the integration of multiple parameters into a joint modeling framework to improve identification accuracy.Subsequently, a multimodal temporal feature extraction network based on LSTM-MFM is constructed. This network enables deep modeling of multi-source data—such as voltage, current, temperature, and state of charge (SOC)—and facilitates cross-modal correlation learning.To further enhance the model’s ability to capture both critical time steps and long-range temporal dependencies, an Enhanced Attention Allocation (EAA) mechanism is introduced for feature optimization. This is followed by an improved Informer network to perform temporal modeling and abnormal condition identification.Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves high identification accuracy and low false positive/negative rates across various types of abnormal operating conditions, confirming its potential for application in the safety monitoring of energy storage systems. • A novel multimodal fusion method integrates voltage, current, temperature, and SOC data to capture subtle battery behaviors. • LSTM-MFM with Enhanced Additive Attention optimizes temporal feature extraction, improving anomaly detection accuracy. • An improved Informer with modality-aware encoding achieves robust, efficient abnormal condition identification with low false positive/negative rates.

title_zh: 揭示公众对 COVID-19 认知的演变：美国 Twitter 讨论中隐喻叙事的案例研究
title_en: Unraveling the Evolution of Public Cognition of COVID-19: A Case Study of Metaphorical Narratives in US Twitter Discussions
authors: Kai He；Rui Mao；Tan Yue；Qiawen Liu；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 过去四年来，COVID-19 大流行导致公众观念发生转变。了解公众对 COVID-19 认知的演变对于为公共卫生决策和未来突发公共卫生事件的准备提供信息至关重要。然而，很少有研究关注公众观点如何大规模转变。探索这些变化的一种方法是使用概念图，这是心理学中经常使用的一种方法，用于研究人们如何组织和连接他们的想法。在我们的研究中，我们特别关注人们使用的隐喻，它们是反映概念图和理解复杂思想的重要工具。我们利用一种新颖的计算隐喻处理工具对 c... 进行广泛的分析。
abstract_en: The COVID-19 pandemic has led to shifts in public perception over the past four years. Understanding the evolution of public cognition of COVID-19 is crucial for informing public health policymaking and preparedness for future public health emergencies. However, few studies have looked at how public views have shifted on a large scale. One way to explore these changes is by using concept mapping–a method often used in psychology to study how people organize and connect their ideas. In our research, we pay special attention to the metaphors people use, which act as essential vehicles for reflecting concept mappings and understanding complex ideas. We utilize a novel computational metaphor processing tool to conduct an extensive analysis of concept mappings derived from metaphors found in COVID-19-related tweets. By closely examining concept mapping patterns across different periods, we reveal noteworthy transformations in the public’s understanding of COVID-19. Our study contributes to filling the gap in the existing literature and provides valuable insights into how the public’s perception of the pandemic has evolved over time. These insights can help public health officials design more targeted and effective communication strategies for future crises.

abstract_zh: 为了使解释真正有效，它必须对目标受众（尤其是非专家用户）来说是可以理解和有用的。与以系统为中心的方法相反，采用以人为中心的解释方法对于选择有效且有针对性的解释媒介至关重要。在本章中，我们研究了以人为本的设计在创建人工智能系统解释中的作用，为非专家用户提供易于理解且可操作的见解。我们将探索植根于可解释人工智能（XAI）和人机交互（HCI）的技术和框架。核心目标是研究跨学科方法如何增强解释的可解释性、建立用户信任、改进...
abstract_en: For an explanation to be truly effective, it must be understandable and useful to its intended audience, particularly non-expert users. The adoption of human-centric approaches to explanation, as opposed to system-centric approaches, is crucial for selecting effective and targeted mediums of explanation. In this chapter, we examine the role of human-centered design in creating explanations of AI systems that offer accessible and actionable insights to non-expert users. We will explore techniques and frameworks rooted in eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) and Human-Computer Interaction (HCI). The core objective is to investigate how interdisciplinary approaches can enhance the interpretability of explanations, build user trust, improve usability, and ultimately support informed decision-making. Special attention will be paid to methods that adapt explanations to varying user knowledge levels, foster user engagement, and facilitate critical assessment of the system’s output. Through examples, case studies, and evaluations, we will illustrate these concepts and also discuss the tangible benefits and inherent challenges of implementing such human-centred strategies in real-world contexts. By placing the non-expert user at the heart of the explanation design process, it is possible to transform explanations from complex technical outputs into meaningful dialogues that empower users and foster a more responsible and effective human-AI collaboration.

title_zh: 类比自然语言处理的四分之一世纪：系统回顾

authors: Bilel Elayeb；Myriam Bounhas；Erik Cambria；Amir Hussain
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 类比推理构成了人类认知的基本支柱，使知识能够从已知的结构先例无缝外推到全新的环境中。在计算语言学中，关系比例的操作化已经成为一种强大的、轻知识范式，用于学习、推理和数据驱动的泛化。本文提出了全面的系统文献综述（SLR），跟踪过去四分之一个世纪（2000-2025）的类比自然语言处理（NLP）的体系结构分类、结构转变和经验里程碑。我们严格遵守标准化 PRISMA 指南，汇总并综合了四个不同领域的 43 项初步研究……
abstract_en: Analogical reasoning constitutes a foundational pillar of human cognition, enabling the seamless extrapolation of knowledge from known structural precedents to completely novel contexts. Within Computational Linguistics, the operationalization of relational proportions () has emerged as a robust, knowledge‐light paradigm for learning, inference, and data‐driven generalization. This paper presents a comprehensive Systematic Literature Review (SLR) tracking the architectural taxonomy, structural transitions, and empirical milestones of analogical Natural Language Processing (NLP) over the past quarter‐century (2000–2025). Adhering strictly to standardized PRISMA guidelines, we aggregate and synthesize 43 primary studies across four distinct evolutionary eras: discrete symbolic/algebraic frameworks, distributional pattern induction models, static embedding offset topologies, and deep contextualized transformer architectures. Each paradigm is critically evaluated in terms of mathematical formulations, dataset configurations, optimization metrics, and downstream operational limitations across core language processing tasks, including morphology, machine translation, and sentence semantic alignment. Methodologically, we reconcile qualitative evidence with quantitative benchmark syntheses, formalize axiomatic constraints across sentential domains, and assess potential publication bias. Our cross‐paradigm synthesis exposes critical trade‐offs between symbolic interpretability, vocabulary coverage limits, and continuous vector space distortions. Finally, we establish a forward‐looking research agenda mapping current open problems—specifically focusing on text morphing generation, analogical dataset augmentation, personalized preference learning, and explainable neuro‐symbolic interface integration—to guide future developments in data‐efficient and interpretable natural language architectures.

title_zh: 孪生世界：基于等方差的基于证据的推理的弃权
title_en: Twin Worlds: Equivariance-Based Abstention for Evidence-Grounded Reasoning
authors: Vy Nguyen；Ziqi Xu；Jeffrey Chan；Estrid He；Feng Xia；Renqiang Luo；Erik Cambria；Xiuzhen Zhang
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 知识密集型推理需要大型语言模型 (LLM) 在提供的证据中提供答案。当证据不足时，模型最好放弃，而不是自信地生成不受支持的答案。现有的弃权方法依赖于不确定性估计或证据充分性检查，但都没有测试由提供的证据和模型的内部记忆参数的相互作用驱动的生成推理过程是否真正以证据为基础。一个关键的影响因素是上下文中提到的实体会激活记忆的关联，从而导致模型生成没有证据基础的看似合理的响应。我们提出 Twin Worlds (TW)，一个提高可靠性的框架......
abstract_en: Knowledge-intensive reasoning requires Large Language Models (LLMs) to ground answers in provided evidence. When evidence is insufficient, it is desirable that models abstain rather than confidently generating unsupported answers. Existing abstention methods rely on uncertainty estimation or evidence sufficiency checks, but neither tests whether the reasoning process for generation, driven by the interaction of provided evidence and the model's internal memory parameters, is actually grounded in the evidence. A key contributing factor is that entity mentions in context activate memorised associations, causing models to generate plausible responses ungrounded in evidence. We propose Twin Worlds (TW), a framework for improving reliability in knowledge-intensive reasoning through equivariance-based abstention: unlike invariance, which requires outputs to remain unchanged, equivariance requires outputs to transform correspondingly under entity substitutions. A model grounded in the evidence should produce answers that shift consistently when entities are substituted while their relations are preserved. TW constructs multiple worlds via typed substitutions of the original input that preserve relational structure while reducing parametric priors, and uses equivariance violations as an abstention signal. Across four benchmarks and three model backbones, TW identifies when answers are not reliably grounded in the provided evidence and outperforms uncertainty- and sufficiency-based baselines.

abstract_zh: 对话中的多模态情感-原因对提取（MECPEC）旨在准确识别多模态多方对话中的情绪及其原因。现有方法主要依赖于预先训练的语言模型的判别性或生成性预测，忽视了利用这两种方法之间的差异和互补优势的潜力。本文提出了一种基于多方多轮辩论机制的新颖框架DEC-Debate。具体来说，通过辩论整合不同模型的话语情感分类结果，可以为话语分配更合适的情感标签。随后，多个大语言模型合作...
abstract_en: Multimodal Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction in Conversation (MECPEC) aims to accurately identify emotions and their causes in multimodal multiparty conversations. Existing methods primarily rely on discriminative or generative predictions from pre-trained language models, overlooking the potential to leverage the differences and complementary strengths between these two approaches. This paper proposes a novel framework, DEC-Debate, based on a multiparty-multiround debate mechanism. Concretely, the utterance emotion classification results from different models are integrated through debate, which can assign more appropriate emotion labels to utterances. Subsequently, multiple LLMs collaborate to combine their knowledge, express the causal relationships in each emotion-cause utterance pair, and then explain and update them through multiround debate, reducing the impact of erroneous model knowledge. By enabling independent generation and mutual criticism, our method gradually reaches consensus, enhancing the accuracy and reliability of the inference. It achieves state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization on three public benchmark datasets.

title_zh: 强化学习与社会智力的比较证据
title_en: Reinforcement Learning with Comparative Evidence for Social Intelligence
authors: Roy Ka-Wei Lee；Gianmarco Mengaldo；Paul Pu Liang；Rui Mao；Vladimir Necula；Jack Wei Lun Shi；Adriel Kuek；Keane Ong；Yuriel Ryan；Erik Cambria；Sabri Boughorbel；Nancy F. Chen
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
topics: 情感大模型；多模态与大语言模型；强化学习与决策优化
abstract_zh: 开发社交智能人工智能仍然严重依赖人类注释数据，限制了社交理解模型可以获得的规模和广度。从未标记的数据中获取训练信号的方法提供了一条超越这种依赖的途径，但社会预测缺乏数学和编码中可用的验证神谕。此外，情感、意图、偏好和实用意义等核心社会目标往往是模糊的。相同的行为可以支持多种看似合理的解释，因此很难验证哪种解释最受支持。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了比较证据强化学习（RLCE），这是一种强化学习方法，可以从未标记的对象中学习社会理解......
abstract_en: Developing socially intelligent AI remains heavily dependent on human-annotated data, limiting the scale and breadth of social understanding models can acquire. Methods that derive training signals from unlabeled data offer a path beyond this dependence, but social predictions lack the verification oracles available in mathematics and coding. Moreover, core social targets such as affect, intent, preference, and pragmatic meaning are often ambiguous. The same behavior can support multiple plausible interpretations, making it difficult to verify which is best supported. To address this challenge, we introduce Reinforcement Learning with Comparative Evidence (RLCE), a reinforcement learning method that learns social understanding from unlabeled training data without constructing rewards from ground-truth annotations. Given distinct answers in a rollout group, RLCE constructs evidence tests that identify observable evidence favoring an answer over another, validates these tests against the input sample, and aggregates test outcomes to determine the best-supported interpretation. Tests are regenerated as the policy produces new answers, enabling them to evolve with the policy. Across four benchmarks spanning affect, pragmatics, communicative intent, and preference, RLCE attains the strongest performance among seven methods that use no ground-truth training labels for rewards, including consensus, policy LLM-judge verification, multimodal co-evolution, and rubric-based rewards. Gains over the strongest baseline reach up to +18.93 points. Analyses further show that RLCE exhibits a larger share of reward variation between correct and incorrect predictions than compared rubric methods, can overturn erroneous policy-derived preferences, and benefits from pairwise test construction, compositional test aggregation, and on-policy test evolution.

title_zh: 情感支持对话的情感流语言模型
title_en: Affective Flow Language Model for Emotional Support Conversation
authors: Luwei Xiao；Chenghui Zou；Rui Mao；Tiesunlong Shen；Ning Wang；Xiangpeng Li；Chuan Ma；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）具有先进的情感支持对话，但现有的对齐方法主要依赖于响应级别的稀疏偏好或对话级别的结果，为多轮交互中的顺序策略决策提供有限的监督。这就提出了一个关键问题：如何从整体对话结果中得出详细的过程信号来指导支持策略的逐步调整？我们提出了情感流语言模型（AFlow），它将多轮情感支持建模为沿着对话轨迹演变的情感效用流。 AFlow 搜索不同的支持轨迹并估计中间对话状态和候选策略的效用。它进一步我...
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced emotional support conversation, but existing alignment methods rely mainly on sparse preferences at the response level or outcomes at the dialogue level, providing limited supervision for sequential strategy decisions in multi-turn interactions. This raises a key question: how can detailed process signals be derived from overall dialogue outcomes to guide the gradual adaptation of support strategies? We propose the Affective Flow Language Model (AFlow), which models multi-turn emotional support as an affective utility flow evolving along dialogue trajectories. AFlow searches diverse support trajectories and estimates the utility of intermediate dialogue states and candidate strategies. It further introduces Affective Flow Preference Optimization (AFPO), which uses a flow-balance objective defined over dialogue subpaths to propagate downstream preference signals to intermediate states and learn strategy transitions consistent with support outcomes over the full dialogue. AFlow introduces flow-balance learning into multi-turn affective interaction, providing a process-based approach to dynamic affect modeling and continuous strategy optimization. Experiments on ExTES and ESConv show consistent improvements in strategy alignment, response diversity, and generation quality across different model environments and evaluation settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/chz2025/AffectiveFlow.

title_zh: 人工智能超载：多级分类法和前进的道路
title_en: Artificial Intelligence Overload: A Multilevel Taxonomy and the Path Forward
authors: Julian Sienkiewicz；Beata Bajcar；Jan Kocon；Janusz A. Holyst；Wiktoria Mieleszczenko-Kowszewicz；Przemyslaw Kazienko；Ingo Frommholz；Erik Cambria；Philipp Mayr
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 随着人工智能成为日常活动中无处不在且部分自治的层，它增加了信息量、交互速度、委托决策和监督要求。本文介绍了“人工智能过载”，定义为人工智能增强的需求与人类和机构的关注、审议、验证和问责能力之间持续不匹配。我们提出了跨个人、组织和社会环境的人工智能超载的多层次分类，包括七种类型：认知、信息、交互、协调、控制、规范和情感。利用对认知负荷、自动化偏见、技术压力和算法中介的研究，我们展示了如何增加人工智能机构和人类与人工智能的联系……
abstract_en: As AI becomes a ubiquitous and partially autonomous layer of everyday activity, it increases information volume, interaction tempo, delegated decision-making, and supervisory requirements. This paper introduces “AI overload,” defined as a persistent mismatch between AI-enhanced demands and human and institutional capacity for attention, deliberation, validation, and accountability. We propose a multi-level taxonomy of AI overload across individual, organizational, and societal contexts, comprising seven types: cognitive, informational, interactional, coordination, control, normative, and affective. Exploiting research on cognitive load, automation bias, technostress, and algorithmic mediation, we show how increasing AI agency and human–AI co-adaptation produce new overload pressures. At the societal level, we link AI-driven recommendations and microtargeting with reduced cultural diversity, polarization, and increased susceptibility to manipulation under constrained attention. Finally, we highlight mitigation strategies focused on limited AI autonomy, maintaining control, AI literacy, information access, and complexity-aware modeling to preserve human agency and well-being.

title_zh: 人工智能作为第四次去中心化革命：从宇宙、生物和心理位移到认知去中心化
title_en: Artificial Intelligence as the Fourth Decentering Revolution: From Cosmic, Biological, and Psychological Displacement to Cognitive Decentering
authors: Nicola Bianchi；Amir Hussain；Rui Mao；Keith Oatley；Geoffrey Hinton；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 人工智能 (AI) 通常被视为一种改变经济、劳动力市场、科学发现和社会互动的技术力量。尽管这些影响是深远的，但它们仅代表了更深层次的历史和哲学转变的表面。我们认为人工智能构成了人类自我理解的第四次重大去中心化革命。哥白尼革命将人类从宇宙中心取代，达尔文革命将人类从生物生命的顶峰取代，弗洛伊德革命将意识自我从心灵的宝座上取代，而今天人工智能发起了一场认知去中心化革命，挑战了长期以来人类占据独特且无懈可击的地位的假设。
abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is commonly framed as a technological force transforming economies, labor markets, scientific discovery, and social interaction. While these impacts are profound, they represent only the surface of a deeper historical and philosophical shift. We argue that AI constitutes a fourth major decentering revolution in human self-understanding. The Copernican revolution displaced humans from the center of the universe, the Darwinian revolution displaced humans from the pinnacle of biological life, the Freudian revolution displaced the conscious ego from the throne of the mind, and today AI initiates a cognitive decentering revolution, challenging the long-held assumption that humans occupy a unique and unassailable position at the apex of intelligence. By situating AI within historical, philosophical, and technological contexts, incorporating detailed case studies, illustrative examples, and policy analysis, this paper provides a comprehensive account of cognitive decentering and its societal implications.

title_zh: 人类行为图谱：统一心理和社会行为理解的基准测试
title_en: Human Behavior Atlas: Benchmarking Unified Psychological And Social Behavior Understanding
authors: Paul Liang；Gianmarco Mengaldo；Carol Li；Rui Mao；Keane Ong；Hengzhi Li；Jingyao Wu；Jiaee Cheong；Dewei Feng；Wei Dai；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 使用智能系统来感知心理和社会行为，即通过可观察的行为和社会互动表现出来的潜在情感、认知和病理状态，由于其复杂、多方面和个性化的性质，仍然是一个挑战。通过专门的数据集和单任务系统处理这些维度的现有工作通常会错过可扩展性、跨任务传输和更广泛泛化的机会。为了解决这一差距，我们策划了人类行为图谱，这是一个不同行为任务的统一基准，旨在支持开发理解心理和社会行为的基础模型。人类行为图谱包含超过 100,000 个样本...
abstract_en: Using intelligent systems to perceive psychological and social behaviors, that is, the underlying affective, cognitive, and pathological states that are manifested through observable behaviors and social interactions, remains a challenge due to their complex, multifaceted, and personalized nature. Existing work tackling these dimensions through specialized datasets and single-task systems often miss opportunities for scalability, cross-task transfer, and broader generalization. To address this gap, we curate Human Behavior Atlas, a unified benchmark of diverse behavioral tasks designed to support the development of foundation models for understanding psychological and social behaviors. Human Behavior Atlas comprises over 100,000 samples spanning text, audio, and visual modalities, covering tasks on affective states, cognitive states, pathologies, and social processes. Our unification efforts can reduce redundancy and cost, enable training to scale efficiently across tasks, and enhance generalization of behavioral features across domains. On Human Behavior Atlas, we train three models: Omnisapiens-7B SFT, Omnisapiens-7B BAM, and Omnisapiens-7B RL. We show that training on Human Behavior Atlas enables models to consistently outperform existing multimodal LLMs across diverse behavioral tasks. Pretraining on Human Behavior Atlas also improves transfer to novel behavioral datasets; with the targeted use of behavioral descriptors yielding meaningful performance gains. The benchmark, models, and codes can be found at: https://github.com/MIT-MI/human_behavior_atlas.

title_zh: 熔断还是丢弃？用于解决多模态情感识别中模态冲突的双路径学习
title_en: To Fuse or to Drop? Dual-Path Learning for Resolving Modality Conflicts in Multimodal Emotion Recognition
authors: Jia Li；Lizi Liao；Zhenzhen Hu；Qian Chen；Jinpeng Hu；Richang Hong；Yangchen Yu；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
topics: 情感理解；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 多模态情感识别 (MER) 受益于文本、音频和视觉的结合，但当模态冲突时，标准融合往往会失败。至关重要的是，冲突的可解决性有所不同：良性冲突源于缺失、微弱或模糊的线索，可以通过跨模式校准来缓解，而严重冲突则源于本质上矛盾（例如讽刺）或误导性信号，强制融合可能会放大错误。认识到这一点，我们提出了双路径冲突解决（DCR），这是一个统一的框架，可以学习何时融合以及何时放弃模式。路径 I（情感融合蒸馏器，AFD）使用时间加权的课堂证据执行从音频/视觉教师到文本学生的反向蒸馏，有......
abstract_en: Multimodal emotion recognition (MER) benefits from combining text, audio, and vision, yet standard fusion often fails when modalities conflict. Crucially, conflicts differ in resolvability: benign conflicts stem from missing, weak, or ambiguous cues and can be mitigated by cross-modal calibration, while severe conflicts arise from intrinsically contradictory (e.g., sarcasm) or misleading signals, for which forced fusion may amplify errors. Recognizing this, we propose Dual-Path Conflict Resolution (DCR), a unified framework that learns when to fuse and when to drop modalities. Path I (Affective Fusion Distiller, AFD) performs reverse distillation from audio/visual teachers to a textual student using temporally weighted class evidence, thereby enhancing representation-level calibration and improving fusion when alignment is beneficial. Path II (Affective Discernment Agent, ADA) formulates MER as a contextual bandit that selects among fusion and unimodal predictions based on a dual-view state and a calibration-aware reward, enabling decision-level arbitration under irreconcilable conflicts without requiring per-modality reliability labels. By taking into account the full multimodal context and coupling soft calibration with hard arbitration, DCR reconciles conflicts that can be aligned while bypassing misleading modalities when fusion is harmful. Across five benchmarks covering both dialogue-level and clip-level MER, DCR consistently outperforms competitive baselines or achieves highly competitive results. Further ablations, conflict-specific subset evaluation, and modality-selection analysis verify that AFD and ADA are complementary and jointly improve robust conflict-aware emotion recognition.

title_zh: 入侵途径：非证据上下文如何降低语言模型性能
title_en: The Intrusion Pathway: How Non-Evidential Context Degrades Language Model Performance
authors: Dikshant Kukreja；Gautam Gupta；Avni Mittal；Avinash Anand；Kritarth Prasad；Zhengkui Wang；Timothy Liu；Rajiv Ratn Shah；Aik Beng Ng；Simon See；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 当提示包含非证据上下文时，语言模型会失去准确性：来自不相关领域的不相关语句，或随机的非分布标记，没有竞争答案，也没有与查询的语义重叠。这种噪音充斥着检索增强、工具使用和长上下文部署，但失败却缺乏机械解释。我们将腐败追溯到入侵路径，该路径从 MLP 丰富查询主题和不相关令牌表示开始，鹦鹉学舌的头将前缀令牌内容带到预测位置，而关系读者很大程度上避免了不相关的来源。然而，保留的主题丰富和选择性阅读并不能阻止对更广泛计算的侵入。然后我们就...
abstract_en: Language models lose accuracy when a prompt contains non-evidential context: irrelevant statements from unrelated domains, or random off-distribution tokens, with no competing answer and no semantic overlap with the query. Such noise pervades retrieval-augmented, tool-using, and long-context deployments, yet the failure has lacked a mechanistic account. We trace the corruption to the Intrusion Pathway, which starts with MLPs enriching both query-subject and irrelevant-token representations, parroting heads carry prefix-token content to the prediction position, and relational readers largely avoid unrelated sources. Nevertheless, preserved subject enrichment and selective reading do not prevent intrusion in the broader computation. We then localize part of this interference to a sparse set of attention heads, which we call intrusion heads. Their prefix-derived writes promote distractor-related content, while their reduced support for the correct answer arises primarily from weaker non-prefix contributions rather than direct suppression by the prefix. The same heads transfer across tasks and distractor types and are largely weight-disjoint from the heads that integrate relevant contextual evidence, enabling a class-conditional intervention. Replacing the corrupted last-token residual with its clean counterpart, an oracle probe that requires a matched clean forward pass, recovers 97.6% on average of the distractor-induced drop across four downstream tasks. A deployable mask level knockout of about ten heads, roughly 1% of the model's attention heads, recovers 57% at bounded cost to helpful context.

title_zh: 商业中的道德人工智能
title_en: Ethical Artificial Intelligence in Business
authors: Mohammad Nadeem；Dag Øivind Madsen；Shahab Saquib Sohail；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 人工智能 (AI) 在商业中带来的道德风险推动了对综合框架的需求，这些框架考虑了技术强大但以人的价值为中心的方法。本文提出了一个基于三个协同支柱的新颖概念框架：注意力、意图和干预。注意力隐喻地代表了人工智能系统对偏见、歧视和公平等道德问题的意识。意图强调从设计阶段就将人工智能目标与商业道德和更广泛的社会价值观结合起来。干预强调了人类监督和决策在指导和纠正人工智能行为方面的关键作用。此外，我们通过案例研究证明了注意力、意图和...
abstract_en: Ethical risks posed by artificial intelligence (AI) in business drive a need for comprehensive frameworks that consider technically strong but human value-centric approaches. The current article proposes a novel conceptual framework grounded in three synergistic pillars: Attention, Intention and Intervention. Attention metaphorically represents an AI system’s awareness of ethical concerns such as bias, discrimination, and fairness. Intention emphasizes aligning AI objectives with business ethics and broader societal values from the design stage. Intervention highlights the critical role of human oversight and decision-making to guide and correct AI behavior. In addition, we have demonstrated through case studies that Attention, Intention and Intervention together can help developers, managers, and governance actors mitigate bias and foster trust. We compare the proposed triadic framework to existing ethical AI taxonomies and discuss its integration into corporate AI governance. We posit that the proposed interdisciplinary framework can serve as a guide for developing ethical AI in business.

authors: Rui Mao；Zihao Huang；Xulang Zhang；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 使得直接用自然语言表达符号结构成为可能，但大多数上下文工程方法仍然假设人类或外部管道已经知道模型需要哪些上下文信息。在本文中，我们介绍了基础学习，这是一个两阶段的上下文工程框架，其中模型首先生成支持性的较低级别分析，然后将其重新用作辅助上下文以提高较高级别目标任务的性能。我们在计算语言学中研究这个想法，其中句法和语义层面的中间分析为下游的语用解释提供了明确的上下文。使用统一的指令架构，我们微调 Qwen3-8b ...
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) make it possible to express symbolic structure directly in natural language, but most context engineering methods still assume that a human or an external pipeline already knows what contextual information the model will need. In this paper, we introduce fundamental learning , a two-stage context engineering framework in which the model first generates supportive lower-level analyses and then reuses them as auxiliary context to improve performance on a higher-level target task. We study this idea in computational linguistics, where intermediate analyses at the syntactic and semantic levels provide explicit context for downstream pragmatic interpretation. Using a unified instruction schema, we fine-tune Qwen3-8b with syntactic and semantic tasks and evaluate the approach on pragmatic tasks. Across experimental settings, requiring the model to explicitly infer these low-level intermediate labels before high-level task prediction consistently outperforms both a baseline model and a model trained on the same low-level tasks without being required to surface them at inference time. The results suggest that when context engineering cannot rely on ingenious human-designed prompts, retrieval pipelines, or hand-crafted reasoning procedures, fundamental learning offers a general alternative.

title_zh: 生理安全临床语言模型的神经符号对齐
title_en: Neurosymbolic Alignment for Physiologically-Safe Clinical Language Models
authors: Abdulhady Abas Abdullah；Milena Zivkovic；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 临床大语言模型可以提出事实上合理但生理上不安全的建议。我们研究是否可以通过基于结构化生理知识而不是纯文本监督的偏好优化来改善安全一致性。方法：我们提出了 Neurosymbolic Alignment，这是一种训练时间框架，将 7B 临床 LLM 与基于 HGNN 的生理世界模型在 847K 节点生物医学知识图谱上结合起来。使用稳态约束、多跳路径合理性和药物相互作用惩罚对候选响应进行评分，由此产生的排名驱动迭代的策略 ORPO 更新。评估是根据临床安全基准 (CSB) 进行的，这是一个针对生理学的 2,500 个场景基准...
abstract_en: Clinical LLMs can generate recommendations that are factually plausible yet physiologically unsafe. We investigate whether safety alignment can be improved by grounding preference optimization in structured physiological knowledge rather than text-only supervision. Methods: We propose Neurosymbolic Alignment, a training-time framework that couples a 7B clinical LLM with an HGNN-based Physiological World Model over an 847K-node biomedical knowledge graph. Candidate responses are scored using homeostatic constraints, multi-hop path plausibility, and drug-interaction penalties, and the resulting rankings drive iterative on-policy ORPO updates. Evaluation is performed on the Clinical Safety Benchmark (CSB), a 2,500-scenario benchmark for physiological constraint violations in generative clinical reasoning. Results: Relative to ORPO, the proposed method improves CSS from 69.5% to 90.8% (+21.3 pp), reduces physician-evaluated HR from 14.1% to 5.1% on the blinded subset, and improves DID from 72.8% to 91.6%. These gains are corroborated by an HGNN-independent Rule-Engine Safety Score (RSS: 86.4%, +21.2 pp over ORPO; r=0.97 concordance with CSS). The method also exceeds GPT-4 (5-shot) on all safety metrics despite a 10x parameter disadvantage, and outperforms an inference-time self-correction pipeline (SFT+SelfCorrect) by 11.4 pp CSS. Under synthetic EHR-style noise, 84.2% CSS is retained. Ablation analysis shows that HGNN scoring (-16.2 pp) and iterative training (-11.5 pp) are the dominant contributors. PhysioScore calibration against 200 clinician labels yielded ECE = 0.038 and kappa = 0.91. Conclusion: Training-time physiological grounding produces measurable and independently verifiable safety improvements in open-weight clinical LLMs under controlled evaluation. External validation on real clinical data is required to determine whether these gains transfer to deployment settings

authors: Weisi Lin；Yihao Zhu；Edoardo Ragusa；Benjamin P. Horton；Chi Yan Tso；Luca Dal Zilio；Andrea Marinoni；Erik Cambria；Mauro Dalla Mura；Jocelyn Chanussot
primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
abstract_zh: 基于人工智能的服务的强劲和持续增长导致全球人工智能数据中心的稳步增长，其功耗不可避免地增加。目前尚不清楚这种用于计算目的的能源需求将如何影响周围环境。在这里，我们重点关注人工智能超大规模处理器的散热问题。利用过去几十年遥感平台获取的地表温度测量结果，我们能够对全球人工智能数据中心周围区域记录的温度上升情况进行可靠的评估。我们估计，人工智能数据中心开始运营后，地表温度平均升高2°C，导致当地微...
abstract_en: The strong and continuous increase of AI-based services leads to the steady proliferation of AI data centres worldwide with the unavoidable escalation of their power consumption. It is unknown how this energy demand for computational purposes will impact the surrounding environment. Here, we focus our attention on the heat dissipation of AI hyperscalers. Taking advantage of land surface temperature measurements acquired by remote sensing platforms over the last decades, we are able to obtain a robust assessment of the temperature increase recorded in the areas surrounding AI data centres globally. We estimate that the land surface temperature increases by 2°C on average after the start of operations of an AI data centre, inducing local microclimate zones, which we call the data heat island effect. We assess the impact on the communities, quantifying that more than 340 million people could be affected by this temperature increase. Our results show that the data heat island effect could have a remarkable influence on communities and regional welfare in the future, hence becoming part of the conversation around environmentally sustainable AI worldwide.

title_zh: 探索大语言模型的商业轨迹：商业模式和广告视角

primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 获得数百万个人和企业用户，它们的快速采用引发了有关经济可持续性和商业化策略的关键问题。本文探讨了大语言模型的货币化策略，对现有和新兴的收入模式（包括订阅和按使用付费访问计划）进行了结构化概述。特别强调利用大语言模型独特优势的基于广告的模式的潜力。该论文还提出了大语言模型商业未来的八种潜在场景，从基于广告的、混合的和公共部门的融资模式到开源解决方案和基于区块链的微交易的主导地位。平行绘制...
abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) gain millions of individual and business users, their rapid adoption has raised critical questions about economic sustainability and commercialization strategies. This paper examines monetization strategies for LLMs, providing a structured overview of existing and emerging revenue models, including subscription and pay-per-use access plans. Particular emphasis is placed on the potential of advertising-based models that leverage the unique strengths of LLMs. The paper also presents eight potential scenarios for the commercial future of LLMs, ranging from advertising-based, hybrid, and public sector funding models to the dominance of open source solutions and blockchain-based microtransactions. Drawing parallels to the evolution of search engine monetization, the authors argue that hybrid approaches (e.g., combining advertising revenue with other sources) may represent the most viable future for funding LLMs. This work contributes to a deeper understanding of the commercial forces shaping the next phase of generative artificial intelligence deployment.

title_zh: 提交-弃权循环：为什么语言模型会产生幻觉而不是弃权
title_en: The Commit-Abstain Circuit: Why Language Models Hallucinate Instead of Abstaining
authors: Vy Nguyen；Ziqi Xu；Jeffrey Chan；Estrid He；Feng Xia；Renqiang Luo；Erik Cambria；Xiuzhen Jenny Zhang
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 语言模型 (LM) 通常会产生幻觉，承诺给出自信的答案而不是放弃，即使它们没有足够的信息来可靠地回答。大量现有工作通过检测或弃权机制来减轻幻觉，但模型内部如何首先做出承诺或弃权的决定仍然没有解决。我们通过机械分析来研究这个决定，将幻觉视为没有支持的承诺：尽管表现出无法回答的信号，模型还是做出了承诺。使用因果门控，我们确定了提交-放弃电路（CAC），这是一个稀疏的、因果局部的注意力头子集和支持该决策的 MLP 子层。来自五个家庭和三个家庭的十个LM（3B-14B）......
abstract_en: Language models (LMs) often hallucinate by committing to confident answers rather than abstaining, even when they do not have enough information to answer reliably. A large body of existing work mitigates hallucination through detection or abstention mechanisms, but leaves open how models internally arrive at the decision to commit or abstain in the first place. We study this decision through mechanistic analysis, framing hallucination as unsupported commitment: the model commits despite exhibiting signals of unanswerability. Using causal gating, we identify a Commit-Abstain Circuit (CAC), a sparse, causally localised subset of attention heads and MLP sublayers underlying this decision. Across ten LMs (3B-14B) from five families and three benchmarks, the CAC exhibits a recurring accumulate-yet-undercorrect pattern: commitment-promoting components build up commitment in earlier layers, while abstention-promoting components act later as corrective signals that are often insufficient to overturn the accumulated commitment. Building on this finding, a lightweight policy trained on CAC activations improves decision accuracy by 12.2 points over the model's intrinsic commit-abstain margin, reduces false abstentions by 2.5 times, transfers to unseen benchmarks, and extends to larger models (27B-35B). The CAC is both diagnostic, clarifying how models overcommit, and practical, enabling improved abstention decisions.

title_zh: 通过弗里曼理论对可解释的论证对话进行基准测试
title_en: Benchmarking Explainable Argumentation Dialogue via Freeman's Theory
authors: Yang Sun；Geng Tu；Wenpeng Lu；Min Yang；Erik Cambria；Ruifeng Xu
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 论证性对话涉及结构化的主张交换和支持证据，但构建有效对话系统的进展因高质量数据集的稀缺而受到限制。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 CMV-AD，这是一个源自 ChangeMyView 语料库的基线数据集，专为建模结构化论证交互而设计。我们进一步提出 FTCoT，一种基于弗里曼理论的思想链框架，可以增强对话生成中的可解释性和推理能力。 FTCoT 用结构化的四元组表示每个对话回合：对话摘要、用户论证、辅助论证和响应推理。我们使用大型语言模型（LLM）构建 FTCoT，利用它们的推理和数据注释能力......
abstract_en: Argumentative dialogue involves structured exchanges of claims and supporting evidence, yet progress in building effective dialogue systems is limited by the scarcity of high-quality datasets. To address this, we introduce CMV-AD, a baseline dataset derived from the ChangeMyView corpus, designed for modeling structured argumentative interactions. We further propose FTCoT, a Freeman’s Theory-based Chain-of-Thought framework that enhances interpretability and reasoning in dialogue generation. FTCoT represents each dialogue turn with a structured quadruple: Dialogue Summary, User Argument, Assistant Argument, and Response Reasoning. We construct FTCoT using large language models (LLMs), leveraging their capabilities in reasoning and data annotation. Extensive automatic and human evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of FTCoT in improving both the interpretability and quality of generated responses.

title_en: Learning Structured Emotional Dynamics in Latent Space via Trajectory Modeling and Controlled Transitions

abstract_zh: 对文本的情感理解主要是通过离散分类来实现的。然而，心理学和神经科学的观点表明，情感状态也可能是连续的、上下文相关的和时间结构化的。在此基础上，我们研究了情感表示作为Transformer嵌入空间中的潜在动态轨迹。在四种Transformer架构中使用 GoEmotions 和 MELD，我们分析了学习情感状态的几何组织和时间演化。我们发现潜在轨迹表现出时间持久性和结构化过渡动态，而预测情绪变化期间错误会增加，表明违反了预期。我们还引入了轨迹级 l...
abstract_en: Emotion understanding from text has predominantly been approached through discrete classification.Yet perspectives in psychology and neuroscience suggest affective states may also be continuous, context-dependent, and temporally structured.Building on this, we investigate emotion representations as latent dynamical trajectories within transformer embedding spaces.Using GoEmotions and MELD across four transformer architectures, we analyze the geometric organization and temporal evolution of learned emotional states.We find that latent trajectories exhibit temporal persistence and structured transition dynamics, while prediction error increases during emotion shifts, signaling expectation violation.We additionally introduce trajectory-level latent interventions for controlled emotional transitions through directional operations in representation space.Finally, manifold capacity analysis reveals partially aligned and variably separable emotional manifolds, suggesting shared geometric organization across affective representations.

title_en: Transfer Learning for Cross-Domain Sentiment Classification via Domain Adaptation
authors: Abhijit Kumar；Agampreet Saini；Rahul Kumar Singh；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 用户生成的内容在在线平台上呈指数级增长，推动了特定领域文本数据的大幅增长。因此，情绪分析的出现是为了促进动态、数据密集型领域中上下文感知的实时决策。然而，获得所有领域的大规模注释数据仍然不切实际，因此仍然需要强大的跨领域情感分类技术。这项工作提出了 WBiGe 一种混合域适应架构，它将静态和上下文嵌入与分层 BiGRU 编码器相结合，以利用全局语义结构和本地情感线索。使用轻量级卷积架构来提取短语......
abstract_en: The exponential proliferation of user-generated content across online platforms has driven a substantial surge in domain-specific textual data. Consequently, sentiment analysis has emerged to facilitate context-aware, real-time decision making in dynamic, data-intensive domains. Nevertheless, obtaining large-scale annotated data for all domains remains impractical, therefore a necessity for robust cross-domain sentiment classification techniques is still necessary. This work proposes WBiGe a hybrid domain adaptation architecture that combines static and contextual embeddings with a hierarchical BiGRU encoder to exploit semantic structure globally and sentiment cues locally. A lightweight convolutional architecture is used to extract phrase level patterns that are usually ignored by sequential encoders to improve short range sentiment expressions detection. To focus sentiment informative pivots and nonpivots during domain drilldown, a class aware domain alignment mechanism based on weighted maximum mean discrepancy is utilized. Furthermore, an iterative pseudolabeling strategy and dual-level attention modules are incorporated into the architecture to continuously improve target domain prediction to increase the interpretability of the model. The proposed WBiGe framework was extensively assessed using the Amazon benchmark dataset, in which it significantly outperforms the existing models across a wide range of cross-domain classification tasks with a record peak accuracy of 92.75%.

title_zh: 显着图可以标记新医院的胸片分类器错误吗？外部验证研究

authors: Aashish Chapagai；Angad Singh Gurtatta；Erik Cambria

abstract_zh: 显着性地图被提供作为医学图像分类器的保障，但它们是否揭示新医院的个体错误仍然很大程度上未经测试。我们在 NIH ChestX-ray14 上训练了一个卷积网络和一个视觉转换器，并在训练医院以及美国和越南的两个外部站点评估了每个模型的 303,768 个决策，并带有放射科医生共识标签。我们根据每个解释的解剖丰富度、分割胸部区域的面积归一化归因浓度对每个解释进行评分，并测试它是否检测到超出模型置信度的错误。 Grad-CAM 的局部发现频率低于放射科医生（命中率最多为 0.575 比 0.888）。向基于置信度的错误检测器添加丰富内容可以...
abstract_en: Saliency maps are offered as a safeguard for medical image classifiers, but whether they reveal individual errors at a new hospital remains largely untested. We trained a convolutional network and a vision transformer on NIH ChestX-ray14 and evaluated 303,768 decisions per model at the training hospital and at two external sites, in the USA and Vietnam, with radiologist-consensus labels. We scored each explanation by its anatomical enrichment, the area-normalized concentration of attribution in a segmented thoracic region, and tested whether it detects errors beyond the model's confidence. Grad-CAM localized findings less often than radiologists (hit rate at most 0.575 versus 0.888). Adding enrichment to a confidence-based error detector calibrated at the training hospital never raised its area under the curve by more than 0.011, and for the convolutional network the relation between enrichment and correctness reversed between hospitals, degrading the transferred detector. Model confidence, not saliency, should anchor deployment monitoring.

title_zh: 心理保健的情感语言处理：整个护理连续体中基于大语言模型的方法的调查
title_en: Affective Language Processing for Mental Healthcare: A Survey of LLM-Based Approaches across the Care Continuum
authors: Jialun Wu；Kai He；Onno Pepijn Kampman；Gerard Chung；Wilson Wen Bin Goh；Qika Lin；Jiaxing Xu；Yanrui Du；Xuequn Shang；Erik Cambria；Mengling Feng

topics: 情感大模型；情感智能；多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 心理保健从根本上是由通过语言表达的情感现象介导的，包括情绪表露、情绪状态变化、认知评估和治疗联盟的关系动态。大语言模型 (LLM) 提供了在心理健康工作流程中对这些信号进行建模的新机会，但其临床价值取决于它们是否能够可靠地识别、跟踪和响应上下文中的影响。这项调查通过情感计算视角回顾了基于大语言模型的心理保健方法，围绕情感表达和情感识别、同理心和治疗联盟、情感对话管理、纵向用户状态跟踪和情感感知安全组织文献。我们...
abstract_en: Mental healthcare is fundamentally mediated by affective phenomena expressed through language, including emotional disclosure, shifting mood states, cognitive appraisals, and the relational dynamics of therapeutic alliance. Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to model these signals across mental health workflows, but their clinical value depends on whether they can reliably recognize, track, and respond to affect in context. This survey reviews LLM-based approaches to mental healthcare through an affective computing lens, organizing the literature around emotional expression and affect recognition, empathy and therapeutic alliance, affective dialogue management, longitudinal user-state tracking, and affect-aware safety. We situate these capabilities along a language-mediated care continuum spanning screening and triage, assessment, diagnosis and risk reasoning, and intervention and decision support, linked by iterative follow-up and affective feedback over time. Covering studies published between 2019 and October 2025, we trace the shift from scripted and task-specific NLP systems to LLM-based approaches with stronger contextual understanding and more adaptive response generation, and introduce a three level taxonomy connecting methodological foundations, service level applications, and assurance requirements. Across six major research lines, we synthesize current evidence, identify persistent gaps in evaluation and deployment, and outline directions for clinically grounded, affect-aware, and patient-centered mental health systems.

title_zh: 医疗保健和医学领域的大语言模型推理调查：个体建模和协作智能体
title_en: A survey of LLM reasoning in healthcare and medicine: Individual modeling and collaborative agents
authors: Qika Lin；Luwei Xiao；Bin Pu；Kaize Shi；Yanrui Du；Jiaxing Xu；Kai He；Shuai Zhao；Jian Zhang；Erik Cambria；Swapnil Mishra；Mengling Feng
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；强化学习与决策优化；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 正在迅速改变智能医疗保健和医学。然而，它们的成功临床部署取决于可靠且可解释的医学推理，而不是表面水平的文本生成。这项调查回顾了医学大语言模型推理。它涵盖基础数据集、训练时优化、测试时推理、协作智能体和推理评估。我们区分两个互补的设计轴。个体模型优化通过监督微调、基于强化的微调或测试时间控制来改善模型或模块的推理行为。协作智能体设计指定一个或多个此类模块如何交换证据、调用工具和聚合决策……
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming intelligent healthcare and medicine. However, their successful clinical deployment depends on reliable and explainable medical reasoning rather than surface-level text generation. This survey reviews LLM reasoning in medicine. It covers foundational datasets, training-time optimization, test-time reasoning, collaborative agents, and reasoning evaluation. We distinguish two complementary design axes. Individual-model optimization improves the reasoning behavior of a model or module through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement-based fine-tuning, or test-time control. Collaborative-agent design specifies how one or more such modules exchange evidence, invoke tools, and aggregate decisions at the system level. Collaborative-agent design does not replace individual-model optimization. Contemporary agent systems commonly compose prompted or individually trained modules, including SFT- and GRPO-optimized planners, routers, and aggregators. This compositional view clarifies both the promise and the current limitations of agents. Structured collaboration can support transparency, error recovery, and heterogeneous evidence integration in workflow-oriented tasks. However, it does not provide an inherent advantage over a strong single LLM on narrowly scoped questions. Combining individual-model optimization with collaborative-agent design offers substantial potential for advancing future medical intelligence.

abstract_en: Code and trained models accompanying the paper "Can saliency maps flag chest radiograph classifier errors at a new hospital? An external validation study" by Aashish Chapagai, Angad Singh Gurtatta and Erik Cambria. The study tests whether saliency maps from a DenseNet-121 and a ViT-B/16 chest radiograph classifier, trained on NIH ChestX-ray14, can detect the classifiers' errors at the training hospital and at two external hospitals (CheXpert and VinDr-CXR), beyond the models' own confidence. abstract_zh: 讽刺是一种独特的交流方式，旨在传达与其字面解释相反的含义。随着社交网络的迅速普及，多模态讽刺的各种表现形式已经变得普遍。因此，人们越来越重视通过多模式数据传达的辨别讽刺。现有的研究通常只提供对图像的肤浅解释，缺乏对图像中嵌入的上下文细微差别的彻底探索，特别是在理解图像中描绘的场景方面。在本文中，我们的目标是更深入地研究图像中嵌入的信息。具体来说，我们首先从图像中提取实体关系以捕获它们的上下文信息......
abstract_en: Sarcasm functions as a distinct mode of communication, intended to convey a meaning contrary to its literal interpretation. With the rapid proliferation of social networks, various manifestations of multimodal sarcasm have become widespread. Consequently, there is a growing emphasis on discerning sarcasm conveyed through multimodal data. Existing research often provides only a superficial interpretation of images, lacking a thorough exploration of the contextual nuances embedded within, particularly in understanding the scene depicted in the image. In this paper, we aim to delve deeper into the information embedded within images. Specifically, we begin by extracting entity relationships from images to capture the contextual information they convey. Additionally, we utilize image text recognition to extract textual information from the images. After conducting a comprehensive analysis of the image information, we establish consistency modeling between the image content and text using external knowledge. Finally, we employ a graph neural network to process the constructed cross-modal graph and make predictions regarding sarcasm. Extensive experiments validate the state-of-the-art performance of our model on publicly available multimodal Twitter datasets.

abstract_zh: 个性化情感对话系统对于心理健康应用至关重要，其中的响应必须在情感上适当并针对个人用户量身定制。然而，大多数现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法依赖于确定性个性化，忽略了情感理解的不确定性，并且在隐私限制下难以部署。在本文中，我们提出了 PALLM，一种个性化情感大语言建模框架，专为保护隐私的心理健康对话而设计。 PALLM 将个性化分解为两个互补的组件：捕获稳定用户偏好的确定性个性化层，以及对动态情绪状态进行建模的贝叶斯情感表示层……
abstract_en: Personalized affective dialogue systems are critical for mental health applications, where responses must be emotionally appropriate and tailored to individual users. However, most existing large language model (LLM) based approaches rely on deterministic personalization, ignore uncertainty in affective understanding, and are difficult to deploy under privacy constraints. In this paper, we propose PALLM, a personalized affective large language modeling framework designed for privacy-preserving mental health dialogue. PALLM decouples personalization into two complementary components: a deterministic personalization layer that captures stable user preferences, and a Bayesian affective representation layer that models dynamic emotional states and uncertainty. By restricting uncertainty modeling to affective representations rather than full LLM parameters, PALLM achieves efficient and scalable personalization under federated learning. Extensive experiments on EmpatheticDialogues and a real-world mental health conversation dataset show that PALLM improves affective alignment and robustness compared with non-personalized and partially personalized baselines.

title_zh: 用于个性预测的具有关联特征和金字塔图融合网络的认知启发多模态框架

abstract_zh: 多模态人格分析是多模态融合的一个热点。为了充分利用模态之间的关联和互补性，我们提出了一种新颖的认知启发的多模态框架，用于模拟人类听、看和阅读过程的任务。人类倾向于使用两个独立的子系统来表示知识：一个用于表示言语（文本）信息，一个用于表示非言语（视觉和音频）信息。这两个子系统可以独立运行，也可以相互交互。受到对人类认知的这种理解的启发，我们的框架是一种新颖的认知启发方法，可以促进这些模式之间的交互。我们首先使用多模态预训练模型的编码器来...
abstract_en: Multimodal personality analysis is a hotspot of multimodal fusion. To fully leverage the association and complementarity between modalities, we propose a novel cognition-inspired multimodal framework for the task that models human listening, seeing, and reading processes. Humans tend to represent knowledge using two separate subsystems: one for representing verbal (text) information and one for representing non-verbal (visual and audio) information. These two subsystems can operate independently or interact with each other. Inspired by this understanding of human cognition, our framework is a novel cognition-inspired method that facilitates interaction between these modalities. We first use the encoders of multimodal pre-trained models to obtain unimodal features, and then calculate the similarity between two unimodal features to mine bimodal association features. Next, the TransformerMLP is designed to acquire the trimodal association feature. Finally, these different types of multimodal features can be modeled as a homogeneous graph, where each feature is a node, and intra- and inter-modal dependencies between associated features are edges. We present a novel pyramid graph fusion network that models and fuses intra-modal contextual information and inter-modal complementary information in a convenient manner. Experimental results on two public personality datasets reveal that our framework outperforms the state-of-the-art methods.

abstract_zh: 从对话交互中自动检测抑郁症对于可扩展的筛查具有重大前景，但仍然受到严重的数据稀缺和缺乏临床可解释性的阻碍。现有的方法通常依赖于黑盒深度学习架构，该架构很难对抑郁症状的微妙、时间演变进行建模或解释参与者特定的异质性。在这项工作中，我们提出了 PsyGAT（心理图注意力网络），这是一个基于心理学的框架，它将对话会话建模为动态时间图。我们引入心理表达单元（PEU）来显式编码话语级临床证据，构建会话图以捕获心理表达的转变......
abstract_en: Automatic depression detection from conversational interactions holds significant promise for scalable screening but remains hindered by severe data scarcity and a lack of clinical interpretability. Existing approaches typically rely on black-box deep learning architectures that struggle to model the subtle, temporal evolution of depressive symptoms or account for participant-specific heterogeneity. In this work, we propose PsyGAT (Psychological Graph Attention Network), a psychologically grounded framework that models conversational sessions as dynamic temporal graphs. We introduce Psychological Expression Units (PEUs) to explicitly encode utterance-level clinical evidence, structuring the session graph to capture transitions in psychological states rather than mere semantic dependencies. To address the critical class imbalance in depression datasets, we employ clinically approved persona-based data augmentation, enable robust model learning. Additionally, we integrate session-level personality context directly into the graph structure to disentangle trait-based behavior from acute depressive symptoms. PsyGAT achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing both strong graph-based baselines and closed-source LLMs like GPT-5, achieving 89.99 and 71.37 Macro F1 scores in DAIC-WoZ and E-DAIC, respectively. We further introduce Causal-PsyGAT, an interpretability module that identifies symptom triggers. Experiments show a 20% improvement in MRR for identifying causal indicators, effectively bridging the gap between depression monitoring and clinical explainability. The full augmented dataset is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.31801921.
