abstract_zh: 可持续发展报告对于 ESG 评估至关重要，但洗绿和模糊的声明往往会损害其可靠性。现有的 NLP 模型对这些实践缺乏鲁棒性，通常依赖于泛化能力较差的表面模式。我们提出了一个参数有效的框架，通过将对比学习与顺序排名目标相结合来构建大语言模型潜在空间，以捕获具体行动和模糊主张之间的分级区别。我们的方法结合了门控特征调制来过滤披露噪声，并利用 MetaGradNorm 来稳定多目标优化。跨类别设置的实验证明了优于标准基线的鲁棒性，同时揭示了......
abstract_en: Sustainability reports are critical for ESG assessment, yet greenwashing and vague claims often undermine their reliability. Existing NLP models lack robustness to these practices, typically relying on surface-level patterns that generalize poorly. We propose a parameter-efficient framework that structures LLM latent spaces by combining contrastive learning with an ordinal ranking objective to capture graded distinctions between concrete actions and ambiguous claims. Our approach incorporates gated feature modulation to filter disclosure noise and utilizes MetaGradNorm to stabilize multi-objective optimization. Experiments in cross-category settings demonstrate superior robustness over standard baselines while revealing a trade-off between representational rigidity and generalization.

abstract_zh: 对情感分类器的解释通常是事后生成的，不能保证它们反映标签背后的计算。我们提出了基于事件的情感分析的解释界面。解析器将输入文本映射到解释，自然语义元语言的封闭词汇表中的短脚本组织成十二个类型槽，并且从已发布的语义定义转录的固定规则决策列表仅根据解释计算标签。因此，忠实性保证是因果性和定义性的，而所有经验风险都存在于学习的解析器中，每行蕴涵接口使其可根据输入进行审核。在众包事件描述中，我们经过微调的解析器...
abstract_en: Explanations for emotion classifiers are usually produced post hoc, with no guarantee that they reflect the computation behind the label. We present an explication interface for event-based emotion analysis. A parser maps the input text to an explication, a short script in the closed vocabulary of Natural Semantic Metalanguage organized into twelve typed slots, and a fixed decision list of rules transcribed from published semantic definitions computes the label from the explication alone. The faithfulness guarantee is therefore causal and definitional, while all empirical risk lives in the learned parser, which the per-line entailment interface makes auditable against the input. On crowd-sourced event descriptions, our fine-tuned parser reaches 0.33 accuracy and 0.48 selective accuracy on a small held-out set, suggesting that the interface trades insignificant accuracy difference to a black-box model for a verifiable, inspectable decision basis for first-person event-based emotion analysis. We also release EmoExpl-1200 with per-line verification metadata and the full rule set.

abstract_zh: 精神健康障碍影响着世界各地数亿人，但获得专业咨询的机会仍然严重有限。人工智能驱动的对话系统提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但现有模型面临两个基本挑战。首先，他们缺乏捕捉情绪表达的分层性质所需的双向理解，特别是在渐进式披露的情况下，客户经常在表面上表现出症状，同时隐藏更深层次的创伤。自回归 (AR) 模型按顺序处理信息，当对话后期出现新证据时，无法修改早期的解释。其次，他们未能有效地整合临床基础的相关知识……
abstract_en: Mental health disorders affect hundreds of millions of people around the world, yet access to professional counseling remains severely limited. AI-powered dialogue systems offer a scalable alternative, but existing models face two fundamental challenges. First, they lack the bidirectional understanding needed to capture the layered nature of emotional expression, particularly in cases of progressive disclosure, where clients often present symptoms at the surface-level while concealing deeper trauma. Autoregressive (AR) models process information sequentially and cannot revise early interpretations when new evidence emerges later in the conversation. Second, they fail to effectively incorporate the relational knowledge that underlies clinical reasoning. In this paper, we propose \textbf{BiGraph-Diffuse}, the first large-scale diffusion language model tailored for the counseling domain. We further introduce \textbf{BiGraph-RAG}, a relation-free graph-structured retrieval strategy that relies only on lightweight entity extraction and semantic linking. This design preserves inferential pathways from observable symptoms to potential underlying causes, while incurring zero LLM token cost during indexing. Importantly, these two modules are not merely combined but mutually reinforcing. The diffusion model provides a holistic bidirectional context, enabling the system to defer premature judgments during progressive disclosure. Meanwhile, graph-based retrieval captures the structured interconnections of clinical knowledge. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of BiGraph-Diffuse, and we further provide a solid theoretical analysis to support its design.

title_zh: CASCADE-Net：通过感知线索解耦进行多模态情感分析的分层仲裁框架
title_en: CASCADE-Net: A Hierarchical Arbitration Framework for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis via Perceptual Cue Decoupling
authors: Shanliang Yang；Hao Wang；Yu Kun；Lei Wang；Cong Liu；Tao Wang；Jiebing You；Erik Cambria

abstract_zh: 多模态情感分析旨在通过整合来自语言、视觉和听觉的线索来模拟人类的理解能力。然而，现有的模型常常面临两个关键的局限性：无法区分显性的显性情绪和微妙的隐性暗示，以及无法稳健地仲裁由此产生的多式联运冲突。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 CASCADE-Net（冲突感知信号提示仲裁和解耦网络），这是一种新颖的分层仲裁框架。 CASCADE-Net 基于两个核心组件构建。首先，感知线索解耦（PCD）模块采用受限双通道架构将每种模态的特征分解为显式和隐式表示。瑟...
abstract_en: Multimodal sentiment analysis seeks to emulate human-like comprehension by integrating cues from language, vision, and acoustics. However, existing models often grapple with two critical limitations: a failure to distinguish between dominant explicit sentiments and subtle implicit undertones, and an inability to robustly arbitrate the resulting inter-modal conflicts. To bridge this gap, we propose CASCADE-Net (Conflict-Aware Signal Cue Arbitration and DEcoupling Network), a novel hierarchical arbitration framework. CASCADE-Net is built upon two core components. First, a Perceptual Cue Decoupling (PCD) module employs a constrained dual-channel architecture to disentangle each modality's features into explicit and implicit representations. Second, and central to our framework, is the Cascaded Arbitration (CA) module, which introduces a predictive arbitration mechanism. It trains auxiliary predictors to forecast one modality's explicit cues from another's implicit cues, generating a quantifiable conflict signal from the prediction discrepancy. This signal then dynamically modulates a cascaded attention process, which first forms a preliminary judgment on explicit cues and then leverages the conflict signal to adaptively arbitrate and integrate implicit cues for a refined final decision. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets validate CASCADE-Net, which attains state-of-the-art Acc-2 of 85.84%, 85.92%, 81.15%, and 81.68% on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, CH-SIMS, and CH-SIMS v2.0, respectively. On the conflict-rich CH-SIMS v2.0 benchmark, it exceeds the strongest baseline by 1.15 percentage points in Acc-2, confirming its effectiveness in handling complex, conflict-rich affective states.

title_zh: CEREBRAL：具有心理约束和元认知推理的多模式情绪识别的神经符号框架
title_en: CEREBRAL: A Neurosymbolic Framework for Multimodal Emotion Recognition with Psychological Constraints and Metacognitive Reasoning

primary_category: 情感智能交互、共情对话与社会信号
topics: 情感理解；情感智能；多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 由于跨模态依赖性、时间动态以及对心理一致、可解释输出的需求，多模态情感识别仍然很困难。我们介绍了 CEREBRAL，这是一种神经符号架构，它将神经多模态处理与符号推理和元认知控制融合在一起。它使用答案集编程进行逻辑推理，将情绪沙漏编码为具有动态极性归一化和情感向量的四维情感约束，并结合用于情景记忆的神经图灵机和用于时间一致性的图神经网络。 CEREBRAL 通过跨模式注意力、动态记忆和不确定的元认知策略选择来处理细粒度的情绪......
abstract_en: Multimodal emotion recognition remains difficult due to cross-modal dependencies, temporal dynamics, and the need for psychologically consistent, interpretable outputs. We introduce CEREBRAL, a neurosymbolic architecture that fuses neural multimodal processing with symbolic reasoning and metacognitive control. It uses Answer Set Programming for logical inference, encodes the Hourglass of Emotions as four-dimensional affective constraints with dynamic polarity normalization and sentic vectors, and incorporates Neural Turing Machines for episodic memory and Graph Neural Networks for temporal consistency. CEREBRAL processes fine-grained emotions through cross-modal attention, dynamic memory, and metacognitive strategy selection with uncertainty estimation. We evaluate CEREBRAL across multiple benchmark datasets, where it consistently outperforms neural-only baselines while preserving high symbolic reasoning accuracy with complete logical proof generation. Statistical significance testing confirms these improvements with robust performance under noise conditions and cross-dataset generalization. The symbolic reasoning component demonstrates practical efficiency and generates human-interpretable explanations through Hourglass dimensional analysis. This work contributes a psychologically grounded approach to emotion recognition that balances neural learning with symbolic constraints, offering interpretability alongside performance gains. The framework’s explicit reasoning traces, four-dimensional affective representation, and calibrated uncertainty estimates address key requirements for deploying emotion-aware AI in clinical settings, human-computer interaction, and affective computing applications where transparency and reliability are essential.

abstract_zh: 多模态情感分析对于通过集成文本、音频和视觉信号等不同数据源来解码复杂的人类情感至关重要。在本文中，我们介绍了基于上下文交互的具有增强语义信息的多模态情感分析（CIME），这是一种新颖的时空交互网络，可以显着提高情感识别的准确性和鲁棒性。 CIME 采用以文本为中心的跨模式注意机制来细化语义表示，同时利用图卷积网络通过捕获说话者内部和说话者之间的关系来建模上下文对话信息。这种双重方法能够有效融合特定模态的线索和挖掘...
abstract_en: Multimodal emotion analysis is pivotal in decoding complex human affect by integrating diverse data sources such as text, audio, and visual signals. In this article, we introduce contextual interaction-based multimodal emotion analysis with enhanced semantic information (CIME), a novel spatio-temporal interaction network that significantly improves emotion recognition accuracy and robustness. CIME employs a text-centric cross-modal attention mechanism to refine semantic representations, while simultaneously leveraging a graph convolutional network to model contextual dialog information by capturing both intraspeaker and interspeaker relationships. This dual approach enables the effective fusion of modality-specific cues and the mining of latent emotional associations across modalities. Extensive experiments conducted on benchmark datasets—including IEMOCAP and MOSEI—demonstrate that CIME consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in terms of overall classification accuracy and weighted F1-scores. Furthermore, detailed ablation studies underscore the critical contributions of both the cross-modal attention and graph-based contextual modules.

abstract_zh: 遥感图像字幕（RSIC）旨在自动生成遥感图像的自然语言描述，具有重要的应用价值。然而，现有方法严重依赖大规模注释数据集。在实际应用中，由于遥感数据的标注成本较高，且地物类别的动态多样性，许多场景下只能使用有限数量的标记样本，导致严重的数据稀缺挑战。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了跨模式元字幕框架（CMCap）。首先，我们设计了充分的任务采样策略，在每次迭代中构造大量伪任务，以减少梯度方差并提高数据...
abstract_en: Remote sensing image captioning (RSIC) aims to automatically generate natural language descriptions for remote sensing images, which holds significant application value. However, existing methods heavily rely on large-scale annotated datasets. In practical applications, due to the high annotation cost of remote sensing data and the dynamic diversity of ground object categories, only a limited number of labeled samples are available for many scenarios, leading to severe data scarcity challenges. To address this challenge, we propose the Cross-modal Meta-Captioning framework (CMCap). First, we design a sufficient task sampling strategy that constructs a large number of pseudo-tasks in each iteration to reduce gradient variance and improve data utilization. Then, we synthesize challenging support samples to enhance discriminative representation learning, and propose a task-adaptive cross-modal alignment module to decouple task adaptability from general representation learning, thereby improving the model’s discriminability and cross-task generalization under extremely few-shot conditions. Moreover, we develop a meta-conditioning decoder that deeply fuses task context with query image features to guide a frozen large language model in generating task-consistent captions. Experiments conducted on UCM-Captions, Sydney-Captions, and RSICD demonstrate that CMCap achieves competitive performance across various evaluation metrics and exhibits remarkable generalization capability under extreme data scarcity conditions.

venue: ACM Trans. Multim. Comput. Commun. Appl.
authors: Jing Li；Siyuan Wang；Rui Zhang；Erik Cambria；Kaizhu Huang；Qiufeng Wang
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 甲骨文的识别在中国考古学和文字学中具有重要作用。然而，由于甲骨文人物图像的稀缺，仍然存在重大挑战。为了克服这个问题，我们提出了 Diff-Oracle，一种新颖的多模态条件扩散模型，通过输入参考的随机组合来生成各种可控的预言字符。考虑到使用自然语言准确描述 Oracle 字符样式的挑战，Diff-Oracle 通过引入样式编码器，摆脱了主要依赖于文本提示的传统传播模型。该编码器从现有的 Oracle 字符图像中提取样式提示，其中样式详细信息被转换为文本嵌入格式 v...
abstract_en: Recognizing oracle bone scripts plays an important role in Chinese archaeology and philology. However, a significant challenge remains because of the scarcity of oracle character images. To overcome this issue, we propose Diff-Oracle, a novel multi-modal conditional diffusion model that generates a diverse range of controllable oracle characters by inputting random combinations of references. Given the challenge of accurately describing oracle character styles using natural language, Diff-Oracle departs from traditional diffusion models that rely primarily on text prompts by introducing a style encoder. This encoder extracts style prompts from existing oracle character images, where style details are converted into a text embedding format via a pre-trained language-vision model. Additionally, given the lack of explicit content information for oracle characters, ensuring that generated characters accurately represent the intended glyphs is challenging. Therefore, we pre-generate pixel-level paired oracle character images (i.e., style and content images) by an image-to-image translation model, providing content information for the generation process. Meanwhile, Diff-Oracle integrates a content encoder designed to capture specific content details from content reference images. Extensive experiments on Oracle-241 and OBC306 datasets demonstrate that Diff-Oracle significantly outperforms existing generative methods in image quality and diversity. Moreover, Diff-Oracle substantially benefits downstream recognition tasks, outperforming all existing state-of-the-art methods by a large margin. In particular, on the challenging OBC306 dataset, Diff-Oracle achieves a 7.70% accuracy gain in the zero-shot setting and reaches 84.62% accuracy for unseen oracle characters, setting a new benchmark for oracle character recognition. The code is available at https://github.com/JJJingLi/Diff-Oracle .

abstract_en: Data, code and Supplementary Material for the paper "EconECPE: A Span-Level Emotion-Cause Dataset for Financial Social Media" (IEEE ICDM 2026 Workshops, SENTIRE). EconECPE is a span-level, multi-pair, typed emotion-cause pair extraction (ECPE) dataset built over the complete 2018–2026 r/economics archive. Each comment is annotated with typed pairs: a finance-tuned emotion (7 classes + neutral), verbatim emotion and cause spans, a 16-way economic cause taxonomy, a target asset, intensity and a sarcasm flag. This record contains the frozen annotation specification, JSON schema and prompts; comment manifests with checksums; offset-encoded silver labels (multi-LLM consensus, with vote support), the adjudicated 300-comment gold set and the 100-comment human benchmark; the weekly market panels; rehydration and pipeline code; and the Supplementary Material. No Reddit text is redistributed: spans are stored as character offsets, and the included rehydration script rebuilds the text from the public Arctic Shift archive. Daily market prices (Yahoo Finance) are not redistributed either: tools/fetch_prices.py downloads them over the paper's window. The distilled extraction models are on Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/EconECPE License: code under MIT; annotations and derived data (data/) under CC BY-NC 4.0.

title_en: EduStory: A Unified Framework for Pedagogically-Consistent Multi-Shot STEM Instructional Video Generation
authors: Shuai Zhao；Jayant Teotia；Erik Cambria；Xinyi Wu
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 长视野视频生成在视觉质量方面取得了进步，但现有方法仍然难以在多镜头教学视频中保持知识一致性和连贯的教学叙述，尤其是在 STEM 领域。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 EduStory，这是一个用于可靠的教学视频生成的统一框架。 EduStory 集成了用于跟踪持久知识状态的教学状态建模、用于组织多镜头叙述的脚本引导结构化控制以及用于评估知识保真度和约束满意度的面向学习的评估指标。为了支持严格的评估，我们进一步引入了 EduVideoBench，一个具有多粒度注释的诊断基准，包括教学...
abstract_en: Long-horizon video generation has advanced in visual quality, yet existing methods still struggle to maintain knowledge consistency and coherent pedagogical narratives across multi-shot instructional videos, especially in STEM domains. To address these challenges, we propose EduStory, a unified framework for reliable instructional video generation. EduStory integrates pedagogical state modeling to track persistent knowledge states, script-guided structured control to organize multi-shot narratives, and learning-oriented evaluation metrics to assess knowledge fidelity and constraint satisfaction. To support rigorous evaluation, we further introduce EduVideoBench, a diagnostic benchmark with multi-granularity annotations, including pedagogical storyboards, shot-level semantics, and knowledge state transitions, together with baseline tasks for controllable instructional video generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that domain-aware state modeling and structured control substantially reduce narrative breakdown and improve alignment with instructional intent. These results highlight the significance of domain-specific structural constraints and tailored benchmarks for advancing reliable, controllable, and also trustworthy long-horizon video generation.

title_zh: FedUAF：不确定性感知融合与可靠性引导聚合，用于多模式联合情感分析

authors: Rui Wang；Hui Chen；Imad Rida；Xianxun Zhu；Junqi Su；Zezhong Sun；Erik Cambria

abstract_zh: 由于模态缺失、数据分布异构和客户端更新不可靠，联合学习环境中的多模态情感分析面临着重大挑战。现有的联合方法通常难以在这些实际条件下保持稳健的性能。在本文中，我们提出了 FedUAF，这是一个统一的多模式联合学习框架，它通过不确定性感知融合和可靠性引导聚合来应对这些挑战。 FedUAF 在本地训练期间明确模拟模态级别的不确定性，并利用客户可靠性来指导全局聚合，从而在不完整和嘈杂的多模态数据下实现有效学习。 CMU-MOSI 和 CMU-MOSEI 上的大量实验证明...
abstract_en: Multimodal sentiment analysis in federated learning environments faces significant challenges due to missing modalities, heterogeneous data distributions, and unreliable client updates. Existing federated approaches often struggle to maintain robust performance under these practical conditions. In this paper, we propose FedUAF, a unified multimodal federated learning framework that addresses these challenges through uncertainty-aware fusion and reliability-guided aggregation. FedUAF explicitly models modality-level uncertainty during local training and leverages client reliability to guide global aggregation, enabling effective learning under incomplete and noisy multimodal data. Extensive experiments on CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI demonstrate that FedUAF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art federated baselines across various missing-modality patterns and Non-IID settings. Moreover, FedUAF exhibits superior robustness against noisy clients, highlighting its potential for real-world multimodal federated applications.

title_en: FlowSteer: Interactive Agentic Workflow Orchestration via End-to-End Reinforcement Learning
authors: Haoran Luo；Xiaoying Tang；Qika Lin；Rui Mao；Mingda Zhang；Tiesunlong Shen；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准

abstract_zh: 近年来，智能体工作流已广泛应用于解决复杂的人工任务。然而，现有的工作流构建仍然面临关键挑战，包括依赖于人的工作流构建、缺乏图级执行反馈以及无法在长期构建过程中循环修复错误。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 FlowSteer，这是一种智能体设计智能体工作流的新范例 - 单个智能体本身端到端地设计下游执行器运行的工作流。为了支持这种范例，我们引入了工作流画布，这是一种新颖的可执行图形状态环境，可为每个原子编辑返回经过语法检查的执行反馈。在画布上，我们进一步提出强化进步……
abstract_en: In recent years, agentic workflows have been widely applied to solve complex human tasks. However, existing workflow construction still faces key challenges, including human-dependent workflow construction, the lack of graph-level execution feedback, and the inability to repair errors in-loop during long-horizon construction. To address these challenges, we propose FlowSteer, a new paradigm of Agent Designing Agentic Workflows - a single agent itself end-to-end designs the workflow that a downstream executor runs. To support this paradigm, we introduce the Workflow Canvas, a novel executable graph-state environment that returns syntax-checked execution feedback for every atomic edit. Built on the canvas, we further propose Reinforced Progressive Canvas Editing, in which a lightweight policy agent issues one atomic edit per turn conditioned on real canvas feedback, and is trained end-to-end via reinforcement learning. Moreover, FlowSteer provides a plug-and-play framework that supports diverse operator libraries and interchangeable LLM backends. Experimental results on twelve datasets show that FlowSteer significantly outperforms baselines across various tasks. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FlowSteer-9B2E.

title_zh: FMSA：通过集成即时学习和视觉语言模型对社交媒体进行少样本多模态情感分析

authors: Xuhui Fan；Rui Wang；Xiaohan Yu；Xianxun Zhu；Heyang Feng；José Santamaría；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准

abstract_zh: 社交媒体上的多模态情感分析（MSA）对于理解复杂的情感表达越来越重要，但在数据稀缺的环境中，带注释的多模态内容有限，它面临着巨大的挑战。在这里，我们提出了 FMSA，这是一种新颖的框架，它将基于提示的学习与先进的视觉语言模型相结合，以实现强大的小样本 MSA。我们的方法利用指令感知查询转换器（Q-Former）来动态提取视觉特征并将其与特定于任务的文本提示对齐，从而增强跨模式融合。我们引入了分布式一致性采样策略来构建代表性的少样本数据集，确保约束条件下的统计多样性。评估了阿...
abstract_en: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) on social media is increasingly critical for understanding complex emotional expressions, yet it faces significant challenges in data-scarce environments where annotated multimodal content is limited. Here, we present FMSA, a novel framework that integrates prompt-based learning with advanced vision-language models to enable robust few-shot MSA. Our approach leverages an instruction-aware Query Transformer (Q-Former) to dynamically extract and align visual features with task-specific textual prompts, enhancing cross-modal fusion. We introduce a distributed consistency sampling strategy to construct representative few-shot datasets, ensuring statistical diversity under constrained conditions. Evaluated across six benchmark social media datasets-including MVSA-S, MVSA-M, and Twitter-Depression-FMSA outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving an accuracy of 63.47% and an F1 score of 57.34% on MVSA-S with full data, and 61.25% accuracy with 56.06% F1 in few-shot settings using just 1% of the data. By fine-tuning lightweight components while preserving pretrained model robustness, FMSA mitigates overfitting and delivers generalizable performance. We also release a curated few-shot dataset as a community resource. This framework advances MSA by offering an efficient, scalable solution for interpreting multimodal emotions in low-resource scenarios.

title_zh: FORGE：融合注册梯度消除以实现内存高效的 LLM 培训
title_en: FORGE: Fused On-Register Gradient Elimination for Memory-Efficient LLM Training
authors: Bapi Chatterjee；Zhengkui Wang；Dikshant Kukreja；Aik Beng Ng；Timothy Liu；Kritarth Prasad；Avinash Anand；Simon See；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 反向模式微分计算每个权重梯度，将其写入内存，然后才让优化器将其读回。这种两阶段的时间表设定了现代训练的内存上限：在阶段之间的接缝处，每一层的梯度都是实时的。我们认为，这种物化梯度是分化如何进行的产物，而不是学习所需的数量——我们消除了它。 FORGE 将优化器步骤折叠到后向传递中，并一次将其应用到一个图块中，完全在寄存器中，因此每个梯度图块在生成时立即被消耗，并且永远不会成为张量。融合仅在更新发生时发生变化，而不是其计算的内容：在完全精确的情况下，融合步骤可证明是精确的——...
abstract_en: Reverse-mode differentiation computes every weight gradient, writes it to memory, and only then lets the optimizer read it back. This two-phase schedule sets the memory ceiling of modern training: at the seam between the phases, every layer's gradient is live at once. We argue that this materialized gradient is an artifact of how differentiation is staged, not a quantity that learning requires -- and we eliminate it. FORGE folds the optimizer step into the backward pass and applies it one tile at a time, entirely in registers, so each gradient tile is consumed the instant it is produced and never becomes a tensor. The fusion changes only when the update happens, not what it computes: in full precision the fused step is provably exact -- the identical optimizer update, for every element-wise rule -- and that exactness survives tensor- and sequence-parallel sharding; in the bf16 and 8-bit regimes used in practice it is faithful rather than bit-identical, its deviation bounded and, for the weight store, rendered unbiased by stochastic rounding. Because each gradient tile is born and consumed in the same registers, it is never converted down to bf16 to be stored and read back; FORGE thus preserves the full-precision fidelity that both bf16 and 8-bit optimizers lose to that conversion. Nor is the method tied to one architecture or one optimizer: linear layers are ubiquitous, and FORGE reclaims the gradient memory of any of them under any element-wise rule. Empirically FORGE more than halves the memory of an optimizer step and, at the small batch sizes typical of fine-tuning and continued pretraining, runs about 1.5x faster; integrated into tensor-parallel Megatron-LM it fits 8B training at four times the micro-batch a standard optimizer allows on the same GPUs.

title_zh: GPPLEA：引导极性提示学习，以增强低样本社交媒体环境中的情绪分析
title_en: GPPLEA: Guided Polarity Prompt Learning for Enhanced Emotion Analysis in Low-sample Social Media Environments
authors: Khurram Shahzad；Rui Wang；Xianxun Zhu；Heyang Feng；Ming Ju；José Santamaría；Erik Cambria；Mohammad Jalil Piran
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 社交媒体中准确的情绪分类对于从心理健康监测到市场情报等应用至关重要，但它仍然受到两个关键挑战的阻碍：高质量标记数据的稀缺和多模式内容的复杂性。在这里，我们介绍了用于增强情绪分析的引导极性提示学习（GPPLEA），这是一个统一的框架，通过将明确的极性指导注入到预先训练的语言模型中并利用自我监督的视觉表示学习来解决这两个挑战。首先，我们通过分层采样构建一个紧凑的少镜头数据集，以在极端注释预算下保留标签分布。接下来，我们通过旋转预测来丰富图像表示......
abstract_en: Accurate emotion categorization in social media is critical for applications ranging from mental-health monitoring to market intelligence, yet it remains hampered by two key challenges: the scarcity of high-quality labeled data and the complexity of multimodal content. Here, we introduce Guided Polarity Prompt Learning for Enhanced Emotion Analysis (GPPLEA), a unified framework that addresses both challenges by injecting explicit polarity guidance into pre-trained language models and by leveraging self-supervised visual representation learning. First, we construct a compact few-shot dataset via stratified sampling to preserve label distributions under extreme annotation budgets. Next, we enrich image representations through a rotation-prediction pretext task, and we cast text classification as masked-token prediction guided by a library of positive and negative exemplar prompts. Finally, we fuse image and text embeddings in a shared transformer, steered by polarity prompts that anchor the model’s attention to emotional cues. Evaluated on four benchmark multimodal datasets, GPPLEA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art few-shot and full-data baselines, achieving up to a 2.3% absolute gain in accuracy under 1% training data. Our results demonstrate that guided polarity prompting not only amplifies learning from limited labels but also preserves robust generalization in real-world social media contexts.

title_en: IndicFairFace: Balanced Indian Face Dataset for Auditing and Mitigating Geographical Bias in Vision-Language Models
authors: Mohammad Nadeem；Jiechao Gao；Mohammed Tayyab Ilyas Khan；Aarish Shah Mohsin；Erik Cambria；Shahab Saquib Sohail
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 众所周知，视觉语言模型 (VLM) 会继承并放大其网络规模训练数据中的社会偏见，其中印度人尤其被歪曲。现有的公平意识数据集显着改善了全球种族和性别群体的人口平衡，但它们仍然将印度人视为一个单一的整体类别。这种过于简单化的做法忽视了印度 28 个邦和 8 个中央直辖区的巨大国内多样性，并导致代表性和地域偏见。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了 IndicFairFace，这是一个新颖且平衡的人脸数据集，包含代表印度地理多样性的 14,400 张图像。图片均来自维基共享资源和开放许可网络代表，符合道德规范...
abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are known to inherit and amplify societal biases from their web-scale training data with Indian being particularly misrepresented. Existing fairness-aware datasets have significantly improved demographic balance across global race and gender groups, yet they continue to treat Indian as a single monolithic category. The oversimplification ignores the vast intra-national diversity across 28 states and 8 Union Territories of India and leads to representational and geographical bias. To address the limitation, we present IndicFairFace, a novel and balanced face dataset comprising 14,400 images representing geographical diversity of India. Images were sourced ethically from Wikimedia Commons and open-license web repositories and uniformly balanced across states and gender. Using IndicFairFace, we quantify intra-national geographical bias in prominent CLIP-based VLMs and reduce it using post-hoc Iterative Nullspace Projection debiasing approach. We also show that the adopted debiasing approach does not adversely impact the existing embedding space as the average drop in retrieval accuracy on benchmark datasets is less than 1.5 percent. Our work establishes IndicFairFace as the first benchmark to study geographical bias in VLMs for the Indian context.

abstract_en: Multimodal sarcasm detection (MSD) aims to identify sarcastic expressions by integrating multimodal and contextual cues to capture cross-modal semantic inconsistencies. However, existing studies face challenges: fine-grained sarcastic cues are implicit and dispersed, large generative models suffer from gradient vanishing in classification tasks, and cross-domain generalization remains limited. To address these limitations, we propose InterARM, an interpretable affective reasoning model that introduces a structured sarcasm reasoning paradigm. Specifically, we introduce a three-stage training strategy based on curriculum learning, consisting of 1) sarcasm classification learning, 2) structured sarcasm reasoning learning, and 3) step-selective hierarchical reward reinforcement learning. The model generates reasoning chains across modalities to analyze sentiment polarity and semantic conflicts. We also construct the MSD-CoT dataset with 3,200 image-text pairs with 19,200 human-annotated reasoning steps. Experiments show that InterARM achieves superior performance on the in-domain and out-of-domain datasets, outperforming larger MLLMs such as Qwen2.5-VL-7B and GPT-5-mini while maintaining high interpretability and strong cross-domain generalization.

abstract_zh: 课程学习通过逐渐增加任务难度来帮助语言模型处理复杂的推理。然而，它通常无法生成一致的逐步推理，特别是在多语言和资源匮乏的环境中，从英语到印度语言的跨语言迁移仍然有限。我们提出了 IRIS：交叉强化与渐进分阶段课程，这是一个两轴框架，它将对逐渐困难的问题（垂直轴）的监督微调与反向课程强化学习相结合，以减少对逐步指导（水平轴）的依赖。我们设计了一种综合奖励，结合了正确性、逐步调整、连续性和数字激励，并通过群体相对策略进行优化...
abstract_en: Curriculum learning helps language models tackle complex reasoning by gradually increasing task difficulty. However, it often fails to generate consistent step-by-step reasoning, especially in multilingual and low-resource settings where cross-lingual transfer from English to Indian languages remains limited. We propose IRIS: Interleaved Reinforcement with Incremental Staged Curriculum, a two-axis framework that combines Supervised Fine-Tuning on progressively harder problems (vertical axis) with Reverse Curriculum Reinforcement Learning to reduce reliance on step-by-step guidance (horizontal axis). We design a composite reward combining correctness, step-wise alignment, continuity, and numeric incentives, optimized via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). We release CL-Math, a dataset of 29k problems with step-level annotations in English, Hindi, and Marathi. Across standard benchmarks and curated multilingual test sets, IRIS consistently improves performance, with strong results on math reasoning tasks and substantial gains in low-resource and bilingual settings, alongside modest improvements in high-resource languages. title_zh: LLM推理周期表：推理范式、方法和失败模式的结构化调查
title_en: The Periodic Table of LLM Reasoning: A Structured Survey of Reasoning Paradigms, Methods, and Failure Modes
authors: Rajiv Ratn Shah；Zhengkui Wang；Aik Beng Ng；Avni Mittal；Mahisha Ramesh；Timothy Liu；Avinash Anand；Simon See；Erik Cambria；Ashutosh Kumar
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；强化学习与决策优化
abstract_zh: 推理已成为评估和解释大型语言模型 (LLM) 的核心，涵盖思维链 (CoT)、数学问题解决、多跳问答、代码生成、检索增强推理、工具使用和多模式决策。在本次调查中，我们介绍了LLM推理周期表，这是一个根据推理范式、方法机制、评估设置和失败模式组织了300多篇近期论文的框架。我们将 LLM 推理分为九个范式：思想链、多跳、数学、常识、视觉和时间、代码和算法、检索增强、工具增强或代理以及基于强化学习的推理。对于每一个，我们都会审查方法，包括......
abstract_en: Reasoning has become central to how Large Language Models (LLMs) are evaluated and interpreted, spanning Chain-of-Thought (CoT), mathematical problem-solving, multi-hop question answering, code generation, retrieval-augmented reasoning, tool use, and multimodal decision-making. In this survey, we introduce the Periodic Table of LLM Reasoning, a framework organizing 300+ recent papers by reasoning paradigm, methodological mechanism, evaluation setting, and failure mode. We classify LLM reasoning into nine paradigms: Chain-of-Thought, Multi-Hop, Mathematical, Commonsense, Visual and Temporal, Code and Algorithmic, Retrieval-Augmented, Tool-Augmented or Agentic, and Reinforcement Learning-based reasoning. For each, we review approaches, including prompting, architectural interventions, supervised fine-tuning, verifier-guided inference, reward modeling, retrieval, tool interfaces, agentic workflows, and benchmark design. We argue that LLM reasoning is not a single emergent capability but a family of scaffolded behaviors shaped by model scale, task structure, external memory, supervision, and evaluation protocols. We synthesize recurring failure modes, including hallucinated reasoning, brittle multi-step inference, spurious rationales, weak causal grounding, poor out-of-distribution generalization, benchmark contamination, and unreliable self-verification. Progress is difficult to compare across paradigms because gains may arise from prompting, retrieval, verifier design, or benchmark structure rather than general reasoning ability. The survey connects methods to their assumptions, strengths, and failure modes, providing a reference map of the field and a diagnostic framework for future work. We conclude that robust LLM reasoning will require meta-reasoning, multimodal and temporal grounding, adaptive tool use, and principled evaluation under distribution shift.

title_zh: LLMdoctor：令牌级流程引导偏好优化，用于大型语言模型的有效测试时间对齐

abstract_zh: 让大型语言模型 (LLM) 与人类偏好保持一致至关重要，但传统的微调方法计算成本高昂且不灵活。虽然测试时间对齐提供了一种有前途的替代方案，但现有方法通常依赖于扭曲的轨迹级信号或低效的采样，从根本上限制了性能并且无法保留基本模型的生成多样性。本文介绍了 LLMdoctor，这是一种通过患者-医生范例进行有效测试时间对齐的新颖框架。它将Token级奖励获取与Token级流程引导偏好优化（TFPO）相结合，以引导大型、冻结的 $\textit{patent}$ LLM 与较小的、专业的 $\textit{doctor}$ 模型。不列...
abstract_en: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences is critical, yet traditional fine-tuning methods are computationally expensive and inflexible. While test-time alignment offers a promising alternative, existing approaches often rely on distorted trajectory-level signals or inefficient sampling, fundamentally capping performance and failing to preserve the generative diversity of the base model. This paper introduces LLMdoctor, a novel framework for efficient test-time alignment that operates via a patient-doctor paradigm. It integrates token-level reward acquisition with token-level flow-guided preference optimization (TFPO) to steer a large, frozen $\textit{patient}$ LLM with a smaller, specialized $\textit{doctor}$ model. Unlike conventional methods that rely on trajectory-level rewards, LLMdoctor first extracts fine-grained, token-level preference signals from the patient model's behavioral variations. These signals then guide the training of the doctor model via TFPO, which establishes flow consistency across all subtrajectories, enabling precise token-by-token alignment while inherently preserving generation diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LLMdoctor significantly outperforms existing test-time alignment methods and even surpasses the performance of full fine-tuning approaches like DPO.

title_zh: MAPS：协作推理的多智能体人格塑造

abstract_zh: 与多个智能体的协作推理提供了更强大和更多样化的问题解决的潜力。然而，现有的方法经常受到智能体行为同质化以及缺乏反思和重新思考能力的困扰。我们提出了多智能体人格塑造（MAPS），这是一种通过智能体多样性和内部批判来增强推理的新颖框架。受大五人格理论的启发，MAPS 为各个智能体分配了独特的个性特征，塑造了他们的推理风格并促进异构协作。为了实现更深入和更具适应性的推理，MAPS 引入了一个批评智能体，它可以反映中间输出，重新审视有缺陷的步骤，并指导迭代细化。这种集成...
abstract_en: Collaborative reasoning with multiple agents offers the potential for more robust and diverse problem-solving. However, existing approaches often suffer from homogeneous agent behaviors and lack of reflective and rethinking capabilities. We propose Multi-Agent Personality Shaping ((MAPS), a novel framework that enhances reasoning through agent diversity and internal critique. Inspired by the Big Five personality theory, MAPS assigns distinct personality traits to individual agents, shaping their reasoning styles and promoting heterogeneous collaboration. To enable deeper and more adaptive reasoning, MAPS introduces a Critic agent that reflects on intermediate outputs, revisits flawed steps, and guides iterative refinement. This integration of personality-driven agent design and structured collaboration improves both reasoning depth and flexibility. Empirical evaluations across three benchmarks demonstrate the strong performance of MAPS, with further analysis confirming its generalizability across different large language models and validating the benefits of multi-agent collaboration.

title_zh: MARS：采用苏格拉底式指导的多智能体自适应推理，用于自动提示优化
title_en: MARS: Multi-Agent Adaptive Reasoning with Socratic Guidance for Automated Prompt Optimization

abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 通常在问答范式中运行，其中输入提示的质量严重影响响应。自动提示优化（APO）旨在克服手工制作提示的认知偏差，探索更广阔的提示设计空间。然而，现有的 APO 方法往往存在模板结构僵化和提示空间探索效率低下的问题。为此，我们为 APO 提出了带有苏格拉底指导框架的多智能体自适应推理（MARS）。 MARS 由五个互补智能体组成，并将优化过程制定为部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程 (POMDP)，通过显式状态建模和交互实现自适应提示细化...
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) typically operate in a question-answering paradigm, where the quality of the input prompt critically affects the response. Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) aims to overcome the cognitive biases of manually crafted prompts and explore a broader prompt design space. However, existing APO methods often suffer from rigid template structures and inefficient exploration in the prompt space. To this end, we propose a Multi-Agent Adaptive Reasoning with Socratic guidance framework (MARS) for APO. MARS consists of five complementary agents and formulates the optimization process as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP), enabling adaptive prompt refinement through explicit state modeling and interactive feedback. Specifically, a Planner agent generates flexible optimization trajectories, a Teacher-Critic-Student triad engages in Socratic-style dialogue to iteratively optimize the prompt based on pseudo-gradient signals in the text space, and a Target agent executes the prompt in downstream tasks to provide performance feedback. MARS integrates reasoning, feedback, and state transition into a unified hidden-state evolution process, improving both the effectiveness and interpretability of optimization. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that MARS outperforms existing APO methods in terms of optimization performance, search efficiency, and interpretability.

abstract_zh: MER2026 标志着 MER 系列挑战赛的第四版。 MER 系列为研究界提供了宝贵的数据资源，并提供了以最新研究趋势为中心的任务，使其成为该领域最大的挑战之一。纵观其历史，MER 的重点已经从辨别性情绪识别转向生成性情绪理解。具体来说，MER2023专注于区分性情感识别，将情感识别范围限制在固定的基本标签上。在 MER2024 和 MER2025 中，我们过渡到生成式情感理解，并引入了两个新任务：细粒度情感识别和描述性情感分析……
abstract_en: MER2026 marks the fourth edition of the MER series of challenges. The MER series provides valuable data resources to the research community and offers tasks centered on recent research trends, establishing itself as one of the largest challenges in the field. Throughout its history, the focus of MER has shifted from discriminative emotion recognition to generative emotion understanding. Specifically, MER2023 concentrated on discriminative emotion recognition, restricting the emotion recognition scope to fixed basic labels. In MER2024 and MER2025, we transitioned to generative emotion understanding and introduced two new tasks: fine-grained emotion recognition and descriptive emotion analysis, aiming to leverage the extensive vocabulary and multimodal understanding capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to facilitate fine-grained and explainable emotion recognition. Building on this trajectory, MER2026 continues to follow these research trends and contains four tracks: MER-Cross shifts the focus from individual to dyadic interaction scenarios; MER-FG centers on fine-grained emotion recognition; MER-Prefer aims to predict human preferences regarding different emotion descriptions; MER-PS focuses on emotion recognition based on physiological signals. More details regarding the dataset and baselines are available at https://zeroqiaoba.github.io/MER-Challenge/.

title_zh: MetaCap：少镜头遥感图像描述的自适应元优化

abstract_zh: 遥感图像字幕（RSIC）旨在将遥感图像中的视觉内容转化为语义连贯的自然语言描述。在灾害应急响应、跨模态检索等领域具有广泛的应用价值。现有的完全监督方法严重依赖大规模注释数据。然而，由于场景多样性和长尾类别分布等因素，许多遥感场景与有限的注释样本相关，导致少样本RSIC。为了解决小镜头 RSIC 挑战，我们提出了 MetaCap，一种新颖的跨模式元字幕框架。传统的元学习方法存在优化不稳定和跨模态对齐困难的问题......
abstract_en: Remote sensing image captioning (RSIC) aims to translate visual content in remote sensing imagery into semantically coherent natural language descriptions. It has broad application value in fields such as disaster emergency response and cross-modal retrieval. Existing fully supervised approaches rely heavily on large-scale annotated data. However, due to factors such as scene diversity and long-tailed category distributions, many remote sensing scenarios are associated with limited annotated samples, resulting in few-shot RSIC. To address the few-shot RSIC challenge, we propose MetaCap, a novel cross-modal meta-captioning framework. Conventional metalearning methods suffer from optimization instability and cross-modal alignment difficulties when confronted with large inter-class variations in remote sensing imagery. To overcome these limitations, we propose a parameter-level adaptive optimization strategy that dynamically learns per-parameter update factors and weight decay factors during the inner loop, enabling precise adaptation to varying texture complexity across visual features. Furthermore, a visual-semantic consistency constraint and an inner-loop trajectory averaging mechanism are incorporated to effectively mitigate the semantic gap. Experimental results on the RSICD, UCM-Captions, and Sydney-Captions demonstrate the superior generalization ability of MetaCap.

title_zh: MMOE：通过高效的专家设计实现扩散Transformer的现代化
title_en: MMOE: Modernizing Diffusion Transformers with Efficient Expert Design
authors: Yanhao Jia；Jiepeng Wang；Chi Zhang；Xuelong Li；Haibin Huang；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 现代大型语言模型通过将容量增长与效率相结合来成功扩展，并随着容量的增长控制每个令牌和部署成本。 AIGC 基础模型（AFM），特别是扩散Transformer主干，已经开始采用稀疏专家，但最近的努力主要是扩大总参数数量和稀疏率，而没有导入使 LLM 扩展实用的效率机制，因此生成质量很少与训练和部署成本相平衡。这就提出了一个自然的问题：高效 LLM 扩展背后的架构原则能否以更平衡的方式适应 AFM？我们介绍 ModernMOE (MMOE)，它是 SiT 式扩散Transformer的现代化版本，可系统地...
abstract_en: Modern large language models scale successfully by pairing capacity growth with efficiency, keeping per-token and deployment costs under control as capacity grows. AIGC Foundation Models (AFMs), especially diffusion-transformer backbones, have begun to adopt sparse experts, but recent efforts mostly enlarge total parameter counts and sparsity ratios without importing the efficiency mechanisms that made LLM scaling practical, so generation quality is seldom balanced against training and deployment cost. This raises a natural question: can the architectural principles behind efficient LLM scaling be adapted to AFMs in a more balanced way? We introduce ModernMOE (MMOE), a modernization of SiT-style diffusion transformers that systematically adapts routed experts, shared and lightweight experts, gate-residual routing, and attention-residual information reuse to AIGC generation. Rather than treating MoE as a single plug-in replacement, MMOE studies how different modern expert components affect convergence, efficiency, and generation quality when composed inside a diffusion transformer. Every experiment in this paper is trained on a single eight-GPU H100 node with batch size 256 for 400k steps, an accessible single-machine budget. Under matched training and sampling protocols and at this budget, MMOE reaches lower FID at every recorded checkpoint, that is, it converges faster per training step, than dense and intermediate sparse-expert baselines, and among the sparse variants it attains the best quality-cost balance. Routing analysis further shows stable expert specialization across depth, substantial use of lightweight routes, and modest step-to-step routing changes during denoising. These results suggest that AFMs can follow the balanced scaling path of LLMs by importing proven efficiency designs, rather than by simply increasing total parameters and sparsity ratios.

abstract_en: MRAC 2026 marks the fourth edition of this workshop. The official website is available at: https://react-ws.github.io/2026_mrac/. Centered on affective computing, the workshop emphasizes multimodal, generative, and responsible AI technologies. This year, we received 40 submissions, a new milestone that underscores the growing interest in our workshop within the research community. The workshop has two tracks: Track 1 hosts the MER 2026 Challenge, comprising four tracks: MER-Cross focuses on emotion recognition in dyadic interactions; MER-FG targets fine-grained emotion recognition; MER-Prefer centers on human emotion preferences; and MER-PS integrates physiological signals for emotion recognition. MER 2026 has attracted approximately 300 registered teams, with 108 participating in MER-Cross, 64 in MER-FG, 82 in MER-Prefer, and 111 in MER-PS. We also invite participants to submit their challenge solutions to our workshop. Track 2 mainly focuses on the multimodal, generative, and responsible Affective Computing area. The creation, evaluation, and deployment of emotion-AI models require large amounts of multimodal data spanning RGB images, video, audio, text, and physiological signals. In principle, the development of any AI system must be guided by a concern for its impact on humans. The aim should be to augment and enhance human capabilities, not replace them, while drawing inspiration from human intelligence and prioritizing safety. MRAC 2026 aims to bring together affective computing researchers to advance the development of this field.

title_zh: OmniClimate-TC：热带气旋多模态视觉语言推理的物理感知视觉抽象
title_en: OmniClimate-TC: Physics-Aware Visual Abstractions for Multimodal Vision–Language Reasoning over Tropical Cyclones
venue: ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM)
authors: Luwei Xiao；Xin Wang；Keane Ong；Jiawen Wei；Chenyu Dong；Rui Mao；Erik Cambria；Gianmarco Mengaldo
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 气象再分析通过连续的、物理受限的场对极端天气进行编码，这对视觉语言模型（VLM）提出了根本性的挑战，其感知假设是由自然图像形成的。热带气旋就是这种不匹配的例证：强度极值、不对称、空间范围和物理影响等关键属性是由现场级别的组织而不是以对象为中心的视觉线索产生的。现有方法通过文本对齐或注释来解决这一差距，将问题视为多模式监督而不是表示设计。我们引入物理感知视觉抽象（PAVA），这是一种即插即用的物理感知表示和注释接口，可映射物理重新分析......
abstract_en: Meteorological reanalysis encodes extreme weather through continuous, physically constrained fields, posing a fundamental challenge for vision–language models (VLMs) whose perceptual assumptions are shaped by natural images. Tropical cyclones exemplify this mismatch: critical properties such as intensity extrema, asymmetry, spatial extent, and physical impacts arise from field-level organization rather than object-centric visual cues. Existing approaches address this gap through text alignment or annotation, treating the problem as multimodal supervision rather than representation design. We introduce Physics-Aware Visual Abstraction (PAVA), a plug-and-play physics-aware representation and annotation interface that maps physical reanalysis fields to visually identifiable and semantically grounded perceptual abstractions for supervision and evaluation in vision--language reasoning. Building on PAVA, we construct OmniClimate-TC, a benchmark for tropical cyclone analysis spanning five classes of reasoning and nine tasks, with 243,890 physically grounded instruction-tuning pairs. Using PAVA-aligned supervision, we adapt VLMs and provide evidence that this representation design improves reasoning over tropical cyclone hazard fields. Our results position OmniClimate-TC as a benchmark for multimedia reasoning over structured geophysical fields, and highlight representation design as a key ingredient for physically grounded reasoning in scientific media.

title_zh: OmniSapiens：通过异质性感知相对策略优化进行社会行为处理的基础模型
title_en: OmniSapiens: A Foundation Model for Social Behavior Processing via Heterogeneity-Aware Relative Policy Optimization
authors: Paul Pu Liang；Gianmarco Mengaldo；Luwei Xiao；Chanakya Ajit Ekbote；Ao Qu；Keane Ong；Rui Mao；Mohammed E. Hoque；Jingyao Wu；Sabri Boughorbel；Wei Dai；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 社交智能人工智能系统必须对不同的人类行为任务进行推理，并推广到新的社会环境。然而，行为数据本质上是异构的，包括不同的模式和预测目标，这些数据会在样本之间产生不均匀的训练信号，从而产生不平衡的学习动态，对现有的人工智能模型提出挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了 Omnisapiens-7B 2.0，这是一种社会行为处理的基础模型，明确解决了从异构行为数据中学习的问题。这是通过异质性感知相对策略优化实现的，这是一种新的 RL 方法，通过近似每个样本对策略更新的贡献并使用这些估计来重新平衡样本之间的学习信号......
abstract_en: Socially intelligent AI systems must reason across diverse human behavioral tasks and generalize to new social contexts. However, behavioral data is inherently heterogeneous, comprising diverse modalities and prediction targets that produce uneven training signals across samples, creating imbalanced learning dynamics that challenge existing AI models. To address this, we develop Omnisapiens-7B 2.0, a foundation model for social behavior processing that explicitly addresses learning from heterogeneous behavioral data. This is enabled through Heterogeneity-Aware Relative Policy Optimization, a new RL method that rebalances learning signals across samples by approximating each sample's contribution to the policy update and using these estimates to drive geometrically centered, inertially smoothed advantage modulation for stable training. Omnisapiens-7B 2.0 achieves the best and most consistent performance across 10 behavioral tasks, while also attaining the best performance on all five held-out benchmarks, with gains of up to +12.02% and +9.37% respectively. Furthermore, it demonstrates more consistent and interpretable reasoning traces, supporting reliable real-world behavioral applications. Our model is available at https://github.com/MIT-MI/human_behavior_atlas.

title_zh: PBDD：一种基于提示的学习方法，用于少量社交媒体抑郁症检测
title_en: PBDD: A Prompt-Based Learning Approach for Few-Shot Social Media Depression Detection
authors: Xuhui Fan；Qiang Zhao；Kaize Shi；Rui Wang；Xianxun Zhu；Xiaohan Yu；Heyang Feng；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
topics: 情感智能；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 从社交媒体自动检测抑郁情绪为早期心理健康干预带来了巨大希望，但现有的多模式方法通常需要大量带注释的数据和广泛的特征工程，这阻碍了它们在标签稀缺的现实环境中的部署。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了基于提示的抑郁症检测（PBDD），这是一种新颖的基于提示的小样本学习框架，它利用冻结的预训练语言和视觉模型来从配对的文本图像帖子中识别抑郁指标，而无需进行微调。我们的方法从严格的数据清理和采样开始，构建高质量的少样本数据集，然后通过掩码语言模型对文本进行编码，并通过...
abstract_en: Automated detection of depressive moods from social media holds great promise for early mental health intervention, yet existing multimodal approaches typically require large quantities of annotated data and extensive feature engineering, impeding their deployment in real‐world settings where labels are scarce. To address this challenge, we propose prompt‐based depression detection (PBDD), a novel prompt‐based few‐shot learning framework that leverages frozen pretrained language and vision models to identify depression indicators from paired text‐image posts without fine‐tuning. Our method begins with rigorous data cleaning and sampling to construct a high‐quality few‐shot dataset, then encodes text via a masked language model and images via a self‐supervised rotation‐prediction task to capture deep semantic cues. Multimodal representations are seamlessly fused into a unified prompt template containing a [MASK] token, enabling the pre‐trained model to infer depressive states by language completion. Extensive experiments on both large‐scale and 1 % few‐shot subsets demonstrate that PBDD consistently outperforms state‐of‐the‐art baselines, achieving significant gains in accuracy and Macro‐F1. These results validate the effectiveness and scalability of our framework for depression detection under severe label scarcity, offering a practical solution for real‐time mental health monitoring in social media environments.

title_zh: Prompt-R1：通过端到端强化学习的协作自动提示框架
title_en: Prompt-R1: Collaborative Automatic Prompting Framework via End-to-end Reinforcement Learning
authors: Haoming Liu；Xueyuan Lin；Haoran Luo；Wenjin Liu；Jiapu Wang；Rui Mao；Tiesunlong Shen；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；强化学习与决策优化
abstract_zh: 近年来，各种优秀而强大的大型语言模型（LLM）已被用来解决广泛的人类问题。然而，当面对复杂的问题时，大多数用户往往无法提供准确有效的提示与LLM进行交互，从而限制了其性能。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Prompt-R1，一种端到端强化学习框架，利用小型LLM（作为智能体）与大规模LLM（作为环境）协作，代替用户更好地交互。呈现为多轮交互，其中小规模LLM思考并生成提示，大规模LLM执行复杂推理。双重约束奖励旨在优化正确...
abstract_en: Recently, various excellent and powerful large language models (LLMs) have been utilized to solve a wide range of human problems.However, when faced with complex problems, most users are often unable to provide accurate and effective prompts to interact with LLMs, thus limiting their performance.To address this challenge, we propose Prompt-R1, an endto-end reinforcement learning framework that utilizes a small-scale LLM (as agent) to collaborate with large-scale LLMs (as environment), replacing users to interact better.This collaboration is presented as a multi-turn interaction, where the small-scale LLM thinks and generates prompts, and the large-scale LLM performs complex reasoning.A doubleconstrained reward is designed to optimize correctness and quality of generation.Prompt-R1 provides a plug-and-play framework that supports both inference and training with various large-scale LLMs.Experimental results on twelve datasets show that Prompt-R1 significantly outperforms baseline LLMs across various tasks.Our code is available at https: //github.com/QwenQKing/Prompt-R1.

title_zh: RAMP：基于多模态方面的情感分析的检索增强深度扰动即时学习
title_en: RAMP: Retrieval Augmented Deep Perturbation Prompt Learning for Multimodal Aspect Based Sentiment Analysis
venue: ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing Communications and Applications
authors: Rui Wang；E Xiaosong；Hui CHEN；Erik Cambria；Xianxun Zhu
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
topics: 情感理解；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 基于多模态方面的情感分析（MABSA）旨在通过联合利用文本和视觉证据来推断特定方面的情感极性。尽管最近取得了进展，现有方法仍然面临三个主要限制：它们通常依赖于静态共享提示，对方面相关外部知识的访问有限，并且当多模态线索有噪音、不完整或与目标方面弱一致时仍然容易受到攻击。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 RAMP，这是一个集成了方面感知检索、动态提示生成、缺失提示补偿、分层提示编码和深度扰动优化的统一框架。具体来说，RAMP 首先检索语义相关的多模态......
abstract_en: Multimodal aspect based sentiment analysis (MABSA) aims to infer the sentiment polarity toward a specific aspect by jointly leveraging textual and visual evidence. Despite recent progress, existing methods still suffer from three major limitations: they often rely on static shared prompts, have limited access to aspect-relevant external knowledge, and remain vulnerable when multimodal cues are noisy, incomplete, or weakly aligned with the target aspect. To address these issues, we propose RAMP , a unified framework that integrates aspect-aware retrieval, dynamic prompt generation, missing-cue compensation, hierarchical prompt encoding, and deep perturbation optimization. Specifically, RAMP first retrieves semantically relevant multimodal instances from an external memory bank to introduce aspect-aware contextual evidence beyond the current sample. It then converts the retrieved evidence into instance-specific prompts through a context-aware dynamic prompting mechanism, while adaptively compensating for unreliable or incomplete modalities. The generated prompts are further refined by a hierarchical prompt encoder and injected into multiple Transformer layers through deep perturbation, enabling shallow retrieved knowledge and deep semantic guidance to be consistently integrated. Finally, an aspect-guided aggregation module produces the sentiment prediction. Extensive experiments on Twitter-2015, Twitter-2017, and MASAD demonstrate that RAMP consistently outperforms strong baselines in both Accuracy and Macro-F1.

title_zh: RefleXNet：有针对性的自我反思，以实现准确的胸部 X 射线报告
title_en: RefleXNet: Targeted Self-Reflection for Accurate Chest X-ray Reporting
authors: Xiaoyan Cai；Libin Yang；Rui Mao；Erik Cambria；Xin Mei
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 胸部 X 光片 (CXR) 的自动判读和报告对于减少诊断错误并为繁重的临床工作量下的放射科医生提供支持具有重大前景。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于全局视觉特征和标记级监督，限制了它们对细微异常的敏感性并降低了它们的临床可靠性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了反射 X 射线网络 (RefleXNet)，它将多尺度视觉特征融合和解剖关系推理与有针对性的自我反思学习策略系统地集成在一起。 RefleXNet 首先构建多尺度视觉表示，并通过基于图的关系建模捕获解剖背景。建立在这些...
abstract_en: Automated interpretation and reporting of chest X-rays (CXRs) hold significant promise in reducing diagnostic errors and supporting radiologists under heavy clinical workloads. However, existing methods typically rely on global visual features and token-level supervision, limiting their sensitivity to subtle abnormalities and reducing their clinical reliability. To address these challenges, we present Reflective X-ray Network (RefleXNet), which systematically integrates multi-scale visual feature fusion and anatomical relational reasoning with a targeted self-reflective learning strategy. RefleXNet first constructs multi-scale visual representations and captures anatomical context through graph-based relational modeling. Building upon these representations, we introduce a targeted self-reflection strategy that uses clinically guided feedback from generated reports to selectively refine abnormality predictions and their associated region-level visual features. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-CXR demonstrate that RefleXNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across clinical factual correctness metrics. Notably, our compact 3B-parameter model surpasses several recent models with over twice the parameter count. Additionally, RefleXNet exhibits strong generalization performance in zero-shot evaluations on IU-Xray compared with leading multimodal language models, highlighting its robustness and clinical effectiveness.

title_zh: ResearchBench：通过基于灵感的任务分解对科学发现中的大语言模型进行基准测试
title_en: ResearchBench: Benchmarking LLMs in Scientific Discovery via Inspiration-Based Task Decomposition
authors: Wanli Ouyang；Yuqiang Li；Ben Gao；Dongzhan Zhou；Zonglin Yang；Jinjie Ni；Tong Xie；Shixiang Tang；Yujie Liu；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 在协助科学研究方面显示出潜力，但由于缺乏专用基准，它们发现高质量研究假设的能力仍未得到检验。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了第一个大规模基准，用于在足够的科学发现子任务集（灵感检索、假设构成和假设排名）上评估 LLM，其中“足够”意味着完美地解决这些子任务，完美地解决了整体发现任务。我们开发了一个基于 LLM 的自动化框架，该框架提取关键组成部分——研究问题、背景调查、灵感和假设——来自 12 个学科的论文，并经过专家验证确认其准确性...
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown potential in assisting scientific research, yet their ability to discover high-quality research hypotheses remains unexamined due to the lack of a dedicated benchmark.To address this gap, we introduce the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating LLMs on a sufficient set of scientific discovery sub-tasks-inspiration retrieval, hypothesis composition, and hypothesis ranking-where sufficient means that perfectly solving these sub-tasks perfectly solves the overall discovery task.We develop an automated LLM-based framework that extracts critical components-research questions, background surveys, inspirations, and hypotheses-from papers across 12 disciplines, with expert validation confirming its accuracy.To prevent data contamination, we focus exclusively on publications from 2024 onward, ensuring minimal overlap with LLM pretraining data; our automated framework further enables automatic extraction of even more recent papers as LLM pretraining cutoffs advance, supporting scalable and contamination-free automatic renewal of this discovery benchmark.Our evaluation shows that, across disciplines, LLMs excel at inspiration retrieval-an out-of-distribution task-suggesting their ability to surface novel knowledge associations.

title_zh: ScienceClaw：对自然科学和社会科学领域人工智能的持续自我进化进行基准测试
title_en: ScienceClaw: Benchmarking Continual Self-Evolution of AI-for-Science Agents Across the Natural and Social Sciences
authors: Xiaoying Tang；Haoran Luo；Wenjin Liu；Zikai Xiao；Mingda Zhang；Zhenghong Lin；Tiesunlong Shen；Erik Cambria；Qing Xu
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型代理正在加速科学自动化，但经过验证的执行很少成为持久的程序级改进，并且现有的评估并没有跨自然科学和社会科学的顺序任务来检查这一过程。我们将 ScienceClaw 形式化为固定参数程序自进化，将任务解决、科学验证和程序更新统一起来。 ScienceClaw-Eval 跨越 23 个学科，通过顺序流和独立重置评估来衡量科学正确性、进化增益、保留、跨数据集传输和进化成本。我们的框架通过多轮交互修复可执行工作流程，将重新执行验证的失败-成功轨迹转换为...
abstract_en: Large language model agents are accelerating scientific automation, yet verified executions rarely become persistent program-level improvements, and existing evaluations do not examine this process across sequential tasks in both the natural and social sciences. We formalize ScienceClaw as fixed-parameter program self-evolution that unifies task solving, scientific verification, and program updates. ScienceClaw-Eval spans 23 disciplines and measures scientific correctness, evolutionary gain, retention, cross-dataset transfer, and evolution cost through sequential streams and independent reset evaluation. Our framework repairs executable workflows through multi-turn interaction, converts re-execution-verified failure--success trajectories into linked Skill and Operator candidates, and retains an update only when source-task replay reproduces the repair and independent scientific tasks improve. Code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/ScienceClaw.

title_zh: SEA-BED：嵌入模型如何表示东南亚语言？
title_en: SEA-BED: How Do Embedding Models Represent Southeast Asian Languages?
authors: Raymond Ng；Sarana Nutanong；Wuttikorn Ponwitayarat；Peerat Limkonchotiwat；Jann Railey Montalan；Ekapol Chuangsuwanich；William-Chandra Tjhi；Jian Gang Ngui；Panuthep Tasawong；Yosephine Susanto；Thura Aung；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 多语言文本嵌入通常被认为在独立于视角的语义空间中编码含义，从而在任务和语言之间产生稳定的相似性判断。我们的结果表明这个假设在实践中并不成立。我们推出了 SEA-BED，这是一个涵盖 10 种东南亚 (SEA) 语言和各种嵌入任务的大型基准，旨在系统地检查嵌入性能在任务、语言和语言-任务组合之间的变化。通过广泛的评估，我们发现没有一个模型在 SEA 语言中表现一致；不同语言之间的任务难度存在显着差异，一项任务的成功并不能可靠地推广到其他任务。语言任务分析进一步揭示了高度...
abstract_en: Multilingual text embeddings are often assumed to encode meaning in a perspective-independent semantic space, yielding stable similarity judgments across tasks and languages. Our results show that this assumption does not hold in practice. We introduce SEA-BED, a large-scale benchmark covering 10 Southeast Asian (SEA) languages and diverse embedding tasks, designed to systematically examine how embedding performance varies across tasks, languages, and language-task combinations. Across extensive evaluations, we observe that no single model performs uniformly well across SEA languages; task difficulty differs markedly within languages, and success on one task does not reliably generalize to others. Language-task analyses further reveal highly non-uniform performance landscapes, where performance varies across different language-task combinations. These findings call for closer attention to performance measurements that provide an expansive view across languages and tasks to uncover inconsistencies in semantic representation. Based on these observations, we provide insights for future model development, including data, algorithmic, and architectural considerations.

title_zh: SeticNet 9：通过概念原始发现和时移机制生成情感人工智能常识
title_en: SenticNet 9: Generative Commonsense for Emotion AI via Conceptual Primitive Discovery and Time Shift Mechanism
authors: Luwei Xiao；Tiesunlong Shen；Avinash Anand；Rui Mao；Xulang Zhang；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
topics: 情感大模型；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 可以生成流畅、上下文丰富的文本，但会产生幻觉且可解释性有限。我们引入了 SenticNet 9，这是一种神经符号框架，可以在保持透明度的同时自动进行常识推理。它利用概念基元发现 (CPD) 来学习基本概念，并利用时移机制 (TSM) 通过时间反馈迭代地完善它们。这种组合产生了一个可扩展的、受认知启发的架构，将符号可解释性与大语言模型泛化相结合。实验表明，SenticNet 9 在各个任务中的性能优于嵌入、Transformer和最先进的 LLM，在不牺牲可解释性的情况下提供更高的准确性。
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) generate fluent, context-rich text but suffer from hallucinations and limited interpretability. We introduce SenticNet 9, a neurosymbolic framework that automates commonsense reasoning while preserving transparency. It leverages conceptual primitive discovery (CPD) to learn foundational concepts and a time shift mechanism (TSM) to iteratively refine them through temporal feedback. This combination yields a scalable, cognitively inspired architecture that merges symbolic interpretability with LLM generalization. Experiments show SenticNet 9 outperforming embeddings, transformers, and state-of-the-art LLMs across tasks, delivering higher accuracy without sacrificing explainability.

title_zh: SkillFlow：用于代理编排的流程驱动的递归技能演进
title_en: SkillFlow: Flow-Driven Recursive Skill Evolution for Agentic Orchestration
authors: Wenjin Liu；Haoran Luo；Xiaoying Tang；Mingda Zhang；Tiesunlong Shen；Zikai Xiao；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 近年来，各种强大的基于LLM的智能体系统已被应用于通过任务编排自动化复杂的任务。然而，现有的编排方法仍然面临关键挑战，包括奖励最大化下的策略崩溃、信用分配不透明的高梯度方差，以及无指导的技能进化，其决策通常是通过直接提示大语言模型做出判断而不是从有原则的训练信号中得出。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 SkillFlow，这是一个基于流程的框架，以可训练的 Supervisor 作为智能体，以及具有动态技能库和冻结执行器的结构化环境，通过多轮交互自动化任务编排。 SkillFlow 采用 Tem...
abstract_en: In recent years, a variety of powerful LLM-based agentic systems have been applied to automate complex tasks through task orchestration. However, existing orchestration methods still face key challenges, including strategy collapse under reward maximization, high gradient variance with opaque credit assignment, and unguided skill evolution whose decisions are typically made by directly prompting an LLM to judge rather than derived from principled training signals. To address these challenges, we propose SkillFlow, a flow-based framework that takes a trainable Supervisor as the agent and a structured environment with dynamic skill library and frozen executor, automating task orchestration through multi-turn interaction. SkillFlow employs Tempered Trajectory Balance (TTB), a regression-based flow-matching loss that samples trajectories proportional to reward, preserving diverse orchestration strategies rather than collapsing to a single mode. The same flow objective yields a jointly learned backward policy that provides transparent per-step credit assignment at zero additional inference cost. Building on these flow diagnostics, a recursive skill evolution mechanism determines when to evolve, what skills to create or prune, and where decision gaps lie -- closing the loop from training signal to autonomous capability growth. Experimental results on 14 datasets show that SkillFlow significantly outperforms baselines across question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and real-world interactive decision making tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/SkillFlow.

title_zh: Sonar-MoE：用于内存高效混合专家训练的后向专家更新
title_en: Sonar-MoE: In-Backward Expert Updates for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
authors: Avni Mittal；Avinash Anand；Ashutosh Kumar；Dikshant Kukreja；Kritarth Prasad；Chaitanya Lakhchaura；Rishitej Reddy Vyalla；Erik Cambria；Zhengkui Wang；Rajiv Ratn Shah
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 专家混合 (MoE) 模型的大多数参数属于其专家，标准训练将每个专家梯度保留在 GPU 内存中，直到优化器步骤。这种记忆随着专家的数量和规模而增长，因此随着 MoE 模型的扩展而增长。我们引入了 Sonar-MoE，它在向后传递期间更新每个专家张量并立即释放其梯度。它将向后优化器从密集模型引入批量 MoE 专家张量，因此 GPU 永远不会持有超过一层的专家梯度。当我们使用两个专家内核后端对 bf16 中的 OLMoE-1B-7B 和 Granite-3.1-3B-A800M 进行微调时，Sonar-MoE 将峰值内存降低了 19% 到 22%。它的更新与标准训练按位相同，无需专家梯度裁剪，...
abstract_en: Most parameters of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model belong to its experts, and standard training keeps every expert gradient in GPU memory until the optimizer step. This memory grows with the number and size of the experts, so it rises as MoE models scale. We introduce Sonar-MoE, which updates each expert tensor during the backward pass and frees its gradient right away. It brings optimizer-in-backward from dense models to batched MoE expert tensors, so the GPU never holds more than one layer of expert gradients. When we fine-tune OLMoE-1B-7B and Granite-3.1-3B-A800M in bf16 with two expert-kernel backends, Sonar-MoE lowers peak memory by 19% to 22%. Its updates are bitwise identical to standard training without expert gradient clipping, and held-out loss stays within 0.003 of all baselines. Each step also takes 17% to 23% less time than standard training with global-norm clipping. Updating whole batched tensors rather than individual experts is what keeps Sonar-MoE fast, as it avoids a 20% to 72% slowdown while using the same memory. Sonar-MoE matches optimizer-in-backward over all parameters in memory and speed while still clipping the dense parameters.

title_zh: TailDART：用于金融时间序列预测的计算高效基础模型
title_en: TailDART: Compute-Efficient Foundation Models for Financial Time-Series Forecasting
authors: Chiang Qin Zhi；Ranjan Satapathy；Erik Cambria；Joyjit Chattoraj
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 尽管时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 在高信息密度物理系统中实现了强大的零样本可迁移性，但将过度参数化的 TSFM 应用于量化金融从根本上受到低信噪比、非平稳性和令人望而却步的自回归解码延迟的限制。为了协调表征学习与机构操作限制，本研究提出了 TailDART，这是一个专为金融时间序列预测而设计的密集 268 万参数基础模型。通过将分组查询注意力集成到轻量级主干中，该架构极大地减少了键值缓存带宽开销，与主流标准相比实现了重大推理加速（高达 48.1%）。
abstract_en: Although time-series foundation models (TSFMs) achieve strong zero-shot transferability across high-information-density physical systems, applying overparameterized TSFMs to quantitative finance is fundamentally constrained by low signal-to-noise ratios, non-stationarity, and prohibitive autoregressive decoding latency. To reconcile representation learning with institutional operational constraints, this study presents TailDART, a dense 2.68 million-parameter foundation model engineered for financial time-series forecasting. By integrating grouped-query attention into a lightweight backbone, the architecture drastically reduces Key-Value cache memory bandwidth overhead, achieving major inference acceleration (up to 48.1%) over prevailing state-of-the-art TSFMs to enable low-latency, high-throughput streaming execution. Furthermore, multi-asset benchmarks across varying temporal resolutions show that a compact model can remain competitive for market forecasting: TailDART matches the predictive fidelity of substantially larger baselines while demonstrating superior error resilience in high-volatility regimes.

title_zh: TEMPO：多模态情感中每样本优化模态的训练时间平衡
title_en: TEMPO: Training-time Equilibration of Modalities for Per-sample Optimization in Multimodal Sentiment
authors: Yi Zhao；Erik Cambria；E Xiaosong；Xianxun Zhu
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
topics: 情感理解；情感智能；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 多模态情感模型通常会过度依赖“最简单”的模态（通常是文本），从而导致三个耦合的子问题：（i）表示级别的优势，较弱的模态对融合表示的贡献很小； (ii) 优化级优势，最强的模态驱动大多数梯度更新并抑制其他模态的学习； (iii) 鲁棒性下降，即音频或视觉在测试时出现噪声或丢失输入时出现故障。我们提出了 TEMPO，这是一个即插即用的训练框架，它通过重新平衡跨模式的学习压力同时保持推理不变来缓解这些问题。对于每个小批量，TEMPO 估计相对模态强度并应用两个同步的、仅训练的 c...
abstract_en: Multimodal sentiment models often become over-reliant on the “easiest” modality (typically text), leading to three coupled sub-problems: (i)representation-level dominance, where weaker modalities contribute little to the fused representation; (ii)optimization-level dominance, where the strongest modality drives most gradient updates and suppresses learning in others; and (iii)robustness degradation, where audio or vision fail under noise or missing inputs at test time. We present TEMPO, a plug-and-play training framework that mitigates these issues by rebalancing learning pressure across modalities while leaving inference unchanged. For each mini-batch, TEMPO estimates relative modality strength and applies two synchronized, training-only controls: selective forward attenuation and backward gradient equilibration. On IEMOCAP and MELD, TEMPO improves accuracy and weighted F1 over strong multimodal baselines, increases the standalone usefulness of weaker modalities, and offers higher robustness under missing- or corrupted-modality stress. Across three benchmarks, TEMPO improves accuracy by 3.2–6.7% and reduces calibration error by 18–34%, demonstrating consistent gains in both performance and reliability with negligible computational overhead.

title_zh: TextNCA：通过分层局部注意力进行语言建模的神经细胞自动机
title_en: TextNCA: Neural Cellular Automata for Language Modeling via Hierarchical Local Attention
authors: Zhengkui Wang；Rajiv Ratn Shah；Avinash Anand；Kritarth Prasad；Sushane Dulloo；Timothy Liu；Avni Mittal；Dikshant Kukreja；Ashutosh Kumar；Erik Cambria
primary_category: 自然语言处理、多模态学习与通用方法
abstract_zh: 神经元胞自动机 (NCAs) 通过将共享的局部规则重复应用于持久的细胞状态，结合局部感知、权重共享迭代和门控就地更新，在视觉中生成复杂的空间模式。我们在 TEXTNCA 的语言建模中测试了这一原理，TEXTNCA 是一个一维因果模型，其中标记位置充当细胞，窗口注意力提供局部感知，GRUstyle 门更新其状态。其分层变体级联越来越宽的注意力窗口 w ∈ {8, 32, 128} 并重用每个阶段的参数进行 T s 迭代。我们在 SlimPajama 上训练大约 30M 参数的模型 60k 步骤，并在 WikiText-103 上进行评估。TextNCA 跟踪类似大小的 Transformer-6L（60.3 与 52.8 最佳运行 PPL），所以我们...
abstract_en: Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) generate complex spatial patterns in vision by repeatedly applying a shared local rule to persistent cell states, combining local perception, weightshared iteration, and gated in-place updates.We test this principle in language modelling with TEXTNCA, a 1D causal model in which token positions act as cells, windowed attention provides local perception, and a GRUstyle gate updates their states.Its hierarchical variant cascades increasingly wide attention windows w ∈ {8, 32, 128} and reuses each stage's parameters for T s iterations.We train roughly 30M-parameter models on SlimPajama for 60k steps and evaluate on WikiText-103.TextNCA trails a similarly sized Transformer-6L (60.3 versus 52.8 best-run PPL), so we study it as an analytical probe rather than a performance alternative.Reordering or flattening the windows raises PPL by 16.7-70.8,whereas a non-iterating sliding-window Transformer preserving the staged order performs comparably across three seeds.These results identify the narrow-to-wide schedule as the dominant factor and provide no reliable evidence that iterated weight sharing improves perplexity at this scale.Intermediate-state analyses support a preparethen-decode account in which early stages reorganise representations and the final wide stage performs most next-token loss reduction.

title_zh: VIAS：价值隔离激活指导，实现组织的多价值调整和合规性
title_en: VIAS: Value-Isolating Activation Steering for Multi-Value Alignment and Compliance for Organisations
authors: Avni Mittal；Avinash Anand；Dikshant Kukreja；Erik Cambria；Rajiv Ratn Shah；Sandipan Dandapat
primary_category: 情感大模型、知识推理与评测基准
abstract_zh: 组织越来越多地部署必须遵循组织价值观的大型语言模型代理。我们检查激活引导（在生成过程中将向量添加到模型的内部激活而不改变其权重）是否可以提高合规性，而不仅仅是提示。由于大多数场景同时涉及多个值，因此我们专注于多值转向。构建这些向量的一个简单方法是将遵循与场景相关的所有值的响应与违反这些值的响应进行对比。然而，这为不同的值提供了几乎相同的向量：它们捕获一般的合规信号而不是单个值，这限制了它们在组合多个值时的使用。我们提出价值隔离激活步骤...
abstract_en: Organisations increasingly deploy large language model agents that must follow organisational values. We check whether activation steering, which adds vectors to a model's internal activations during generation without changing its weights, can improve compliance beyond prompting alone. Since most scenarios involve several values at once, we focus on multi-value steering. A simple way to build these vectors is to contrast responses that follow all values relevant to a scenario with responses that violate them. However, this gives nearly identical vectors for different values: they capture a general compliance signal rather than individual values, which limits their use when combining several values. We propose Value-Isolating Activation Steering (VIAS), which contrasts responses to the same scenario under two prompts, one listing all relevant values and one omitting a single target value. We keep a pair only if the target value changes from compliant to non-compliant and both responses still meet a minimum compliance level on the other values. We evaluate VIAS on PROTECT, a workplace compliance dataset where each scenario is tagged with relevant values from a 21-value taxonomy. VIAS reduces overlap between value vectors, making them better suited for multi-value steering, although this alone does not lead to independent control over each value. Combined with prompting, VIAS complies with every tagged value on 69.6% of scenarios for Qwen2.5-7B, 75.2% for Mistral-7B, and 72.6% for Phi-3.5-mini, outperforming prompting alone for all three models.
